notes.title: "Blood of Steel" Version Update Announcement – September 25th
notes.content: [p]To ensure the game's stability and enhance overall service quality and user experience, "Blood of Steel" will undergo maintenance on [b]September 25th from 08:00 to 10:00 (UTC+8).[/b] During this period, the game world will be temporarily closed, [b]and game matchmaking will be disabled around 07:45[/b]. Additionally, comprehensive maintenance and backup of the account database will be performed. Please notice that the maintenance time may change based on specific work conditions. We kindly ask all players to plan the game time accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Content：[/b][/p][p][b]1. Common Mount \[Qingqiu Fox] Limited-Time Release[/b][/p][list][*][p]This round's rewards include: Common Contract Mount \[Qingqiu Fox], Supreme Qingqiu Fox Advancement Stone*3, Superior Qingqiu Fox Advancement Stone[b]*[/b]3, along with Awakening Points, Battle Pass Tokens, Diamonds, and Skin Fragments.[/p][/*][*][p]All heroes capable of riding mounts (except special mount heroes Sibylla and Meng Huo) can equip the Qingqiu Fox.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Qingqiu Fox] is permanently limited to 60 draws, and all rewards are guaranteed within 60 draws.[/p][/*][*][p]Draws 10, 20, and 35 guarantee \[Qingqiu Fox Mount] ×1; Draws 30, 40, and 45 guarantee \[Superior Qingqiu Fox Advancement Stone] *1; Draw 60 guarantees \[Supreme Qingqiu Fox Advancement Stone] *3.[/p][/*][*][p]Use the corresponding advancement stones on \[Qingqiu Fox] to advance it and activate corresponding advanced effects; the highest grade \[Supreme Qingqiu Fox] will possess new wind speed lines, rein-pulling effects, and jump effects.[/p][/*][*][p]You can access the draw via the "Moonlit Fragrance" entry under Shop - Skins by consuming Awakening Points.[/p][/*][*][p]The Qingqiu Fox mount sale will end on October 23 at 00:00.[/p][/*][*][p]Qingqiu Fox, Superior Qingqiu Fox, and Supreme Qingqiu Fox all support the freely configurable "Mount model becomes semi-transparent during attack" function.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]2. Mid-Autumn & National Day Events Limited-Time Launch[/b][/p][list][*][p]From September 25 to October 16, the "Sandbox War Games" activity offers a new experience. In the simulated offense/defense troop deployment, exchange for Octavia's soldier skin \[Summer Charm Maiden], event commemorative avatar \[Open Field Troop Review], and numerous other rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]From September 25 to November 6 at 00:00, Octavia's soldier skin \[Flowing Clould Maiden] is available for purchase in "Shop - Recommended - Golden Autumn Direct Sale" for 2980 Awakening Points; after purchase, complete designated tasks in "Activity Center - Ultimate Rebate" to receive up to 2000 Awakening Points rebate (rebate claim period ends November 20 at 05:59).[/p][/*][*][p]From September 25 to October 16, participating in events allows you to obtain the festival-exclusive dynamic loading image \[Laurel Moonlight], multiple festival-limited back accessory selection packs, Qingqiu Fox limited avatar frame, limited-time skin trial sets, and massive other rewards.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]3. New In-Battle Tactics Display[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added in-battle tactics display, including tactic name, icon, status information, etc. Some tactics have special display rules as follows:[/p][/*][*][p]Tactic icons are grayed out by default; when enemies are killed, stack numbers are shown at the icon's bottom right; when the maximum stack is reached, the stack number changes color. Affected tactics include: Aim, Reserve Strength, Promotion (Archer), Promotion (Infantry), Promotion (Cavalry), Army Promotion (Archer), Army Promotion (Infantry), Army Promotion (Cavalry).[/p][/*][*][p]Tactic icons are grayed out by default; when triggered, the icon lights up, and grays out again after consumption. Affected tactics include: Close-Range Archery.[/p][/*][*][p]Tactic icons are grayed out by default; when triggered, the icon lights up and shows stack numbers at the bottom right (if no stacks, no number is displayed); when the maximum stack is reached, the stack number changes color and a countdown is displayed; after the time ends, the icon grays out again. Affected tactics include: Inspiration, Quick Wit, Encourage (Shield), Spark, Sharpshooter, Fighting Spirit.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]4. Limited-Time Skin Bundles Direct Sale[/b][/p][list][*][p]This direct sale includes: Dawn Princess Set (Isabella), Colorful Clouds Chasing Moon Set (Diao Chan), Zulong · Gilded Set (Ying Zheng), Eternal Blooming Rose Set(Octavia),Cloud Ink Fairy Set (Hua Mulan).[/p][/*][*][p]You can purchase them via the "Golden Autumn Direct Sale" entry under "Shop - Recommended" by consuming Credits; if you already own some parts within a bundle, they will be automatically converted into corresponding Diamonds after purchase.[/p][/*][*][p]This direct sale lasts until November 6 at 00:00.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]5. Mid-Autumn Limited-Time Legion Battle Maps[/b][/p][list][*][p]Open Mid-Autumn limited-time Legion Battle maps "Rongzhou Village (Night) 5V5" and "Rongzhou Village (Night) 7V7"; Players can experience them via matchmaking in Legion Battle.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]6. "Time Wish" Rotation[/b][/p][list][*][p]The skin prize pools for the series \[Lost Dream of Fusang], \[Primeval Era], and \[Fashion Journey] will be taken offline on September 30 at 23:59.[/p][/*][*][p]A new round of prize pools will rotate in on October 1, 2025 at 00:00, containing three series: \[Chaos of Troubled Times], \[Demon's Whisper], \[Hundred Years of England and France], lasting 92 days.[/p][/*][*][p]For a single series, every 5 draws guarantees an accessory skin from the set; up to 45 draws are needed to obtain all rewards, and all rewards are bound; the draw progress for each series' skin prize pool is calculated independently and does not affect each other.[/p][/*][*][p]Monarchs who collect a full series set can receive the corresponding avatar frame via mail; after the October 1 pool rotation, players who have already obtained all sets of the new series will have the corresponding avatar frame automatically activated after the rotation, viewable and equippable under Personal Profile - Avatar Frames.[/p][/*][*][p]The following are the contents of the rotating prize pools from October 1st to December 31st:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/68fb85ce2c2dd778d5e57a376189ea5bd868dbae.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/7ff2846e94e2c337a9e19999a091eca6ccb9e2ae.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/7ff2846e94e2c337a9e19999a091eca6ccb9e2ae.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]7. Adjustments to Boxes and Shop Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]To coordinate with the "Time Wish" event, Cecilia's \[Christmas Carol] Box is simultaneously taken offline.[/p][/*][*][p]In "Awakening Path - Points Awakening", the "Skin Selection Box" adds: Snowy Christmas Eve (Cecilia Skin); the "Weapon Selection Box" adds: Snow Magic Wand (Cecilia Primary Weapon), Ice Penguin Leaper (Cecilia Secondary Weapon).[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]8. Limited Skin Box Discounts End[/b][/p][list][*][p]The 30% discount ends for the limited skin boxes: Celestial Consort Box (Sun Shangxiang), Yu Beauty Box (Yu Ji), Peach Intoxication Box (Bu Lianshi), and Goddess of Luo Box (Zhen Ji); prices revert to original.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]9. Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the bug where Zhao Yun's \[Crimson Dragon Sword] would not display on his back.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where the corresponding hero was displayed incorrectly on the Meng Chang Box and Blue-Eyed Death Trial Cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where when using the pedestal \[Rose], the hero was not centered in the results screen display.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug in the novice mission where completing Joan's 3 trial tasks showed incorrect progress and rewards could not be claimed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where the initial expedition mission entry name was displayed incorrectly in the novice mission interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some known skin texture display abnormalities.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the clipping bug when male heroes used long-handled swords to block.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where Marianne's Chinese and English kill quote voice lines overlapped, and the English volume was too low[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content: [p]Blood of Steel will undergo a hotfix maintenance without server downtime on September 5 at 9:00 (UTC+8). After the update is complete, simply restart your game to experience the latest content.[/p][p]Update Details:[/p][p]Fixed an issue where Legacy Heroes could not switch Armor Fragment Loadouts during the hero selection phase.[/p][p]Fixed abnormal behavior in the voice chat system.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support.[/p][p]— Blood of Steel Development & Operations Team[/p]

notes.title: "Blood of Steel" Version Update Announcement – September 4th
notes.content: [p]To ensure the game's stability and enhance overall service quality and user experience, "Blood of Steel" will undergo maintenance on [b]September 4th from 08:00 to 10:00 (UTC+8).[/b] During this period, the game world will be temporarily closed, [b]and game matchmaking will be disabled around 07:45[/b]. Additionally, comprehensive maintenance and backup of the account database will be performed. Please notice that the maintenance time may change based on specific work conditions. We kindly ask all players to plan the game time accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Content：[/b][/p][p]1. Battle Technique Balance Adjustments:[/p][p]a. Added 4 new 60 Battle Technique Value skills:[/p][list][*][p]Army Promotion (Archer): Increases soldiers' max HP by 5%. For every 5 enemies killed by the army, soldiers permanently gain 1% ranged attack (max 5 stacks). (Troop Battle Technique)[/p][/*][*][p]Army Promotion (Infantry): Increases soldiers' max HP by 5%. For every 5 enemies killed by the army, soldiers permanently gain 1% melee attack (max 5 stacks). (Troop Battle Technique)[/p][/*][*][p]Army Promotion (Cavalry): Increases soldiers' max HP by 3% and mount HP by 5%. For every 5 enemies killed by the army, soldiers permanently gain 1% mounted attack (max 5 stacks). (Troop Battle Technique)[/p][/*][*][p]Mount: Reduces damage taken by the hero’s mount by 10%. Summon mount skills refund 8% cooldown after use. (Hero Battle Technique)[/p][/*][/list][p]b. Adjusted existing Battle Technique:[/p][list][*][p]Aim: After standing still for 2s, bow damage increases by 3% per second (max 3 stacks). Resets when moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Inspiration: For every 1000 damage dealt by the hero, triggers \[Quick Wit] (20% increased Strategy, Rage, and resources for 12s).[/p][/*][*][p]Quick Wit: For every 6 kills or hero defeats by the army, triggers \[Quick Wit] (20% increased Strategy, Rage, and resources for 12s).[/p][/*][*][p]Sharpshooter: Reduces ranged damage falloff for the army. Hero hits on enemies beyond 60m grant soldiers 1 stack of \[Inspire] (max 3 stacks; 4% ranged damage per stack for 8s).[/p][/*][*][p]Encourage: For every 3000 damage taken by the army, grants 1 stack of \[Encourage] (max 3 stacks; +10 armor per stack for 12s).[/p][/*][*][p]Spark: For every 3000 damage taken by the army, triggers \[Quick Wit] for the hero.[/p][/*][*][p]Throw: Increases throwing damage by 12%. Throwing skills refund 8% Strategy or cooldown after use.[/p][/*][*][p]Severe Wound: Dealing 300|120 damage to heroes|soldiers within a short time inflicts \[Severe Wound] (2 HP bleed per second for 15s).[/p][/*][*][p]Fighting Spirit: For each enemy defeated by the army, increases melee attack by 1% (max 10%) for 12s.[/p][/*][*][p]Reserve Strength: While out of combat, gain 1 stack of \[Reserve Strength] every 2s (max 5 stacks). Next melee attack deals 6% increased damage per stack.[/p][/*][*][p]Promotion (Archer): Increases hero’s max HP by 10%. For every 3 kills, permanently increases ranged attack by 2% (max 4 stacks).[/p][/*][*][p]Promotion (Infantry): Increases hero’s max HP by 10%. For every 3 kills, permanently increases melee attack by 1% and attack speed by 0.5% (max 4 stacks).[/p][/*][*][p]Promotion (Cavalry): Increases hero’s max HP by 5% and mount HP by 10%. For every 3 kills, permanently increases melee attack by 2% (max 4 stacks).[/p][/*][*][p]Lethal Mark: Removed the ranged attack increase effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Melee: Attackers gain 1 stack of \[Exhaustion] per hit (max 3 stacks; -2% attack per stack). If killed under this effect, the killer recovers HP based on stacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Assassination Expertise: Increases headshot and backstab damage by 6% for the army. Restores 3% of damage dealt as HP on headshots or backstabs.[/p][/*][/list][p]c. All heroes now have 3 skills in the 60 Battle Technique Value category.[/p][p]d. Balance adjustments and replacements for some heroes’ Battle Technique libraries.[/p][p]e. Updated the system-recommended plan configurations.[/p][p][/p][p]2. Gameplay Lab Optimizations:[/p][p]a. Added tactic modification options in the hero selection interface.[/p][p]b. Added AI bots during matchmaking to reduce waiting times.[/p][p][/p][p]3. Bug Fixes:[/p][p]a. Fixed a bug where switching regions during Mercenary World matchmaking would incorrectly disable the function without updating the UI.[/p][p]b. Fixed missing hit effects and sound for Godfrey/Ada’s gold Shining Stone \[Splendid Sound of the Sanctuary].[/p][p]c. Fixed display issues with Isabella’s secondary weapon \[Sword of Redemption] when equipped with the Golden Flame effect.[/p][p]d. Fixed abnormal model display for Iga Oboro’s head during the cloak.[/p][p]e. Fixed incorrect display of Octavia’s name in the English language environment.[/p]

notes.title: "Blood of Steel" Version Update Announcement – August 7th

We kindly ask all players to plan the game time accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Content：[/b][/p][olist][*][p]New map "Diaoyu Fortress" is now available. Players level 50 and above can initiate 5v5 and 7v7 Legion Battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Added mounts "Snow-treading Elk and "Frost-Seeking Elk" for Fan Lihua to the "Mount Transparency During Attacks" feature.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the purchase logic for contract weapons in the Auction House. notes.title: "Blood of Steel" Version Update Announcement – July 24th
notes.content: [p]To ensure the game's stability and enhance overall service quality and user experience, "Blood of Steel" will undergo maintenance on [b]July 24th from 07:00 to 12:00 (UTC+8)[/b]. During this period, the game world will be temporarily closed, [b]and game matchmaking will be disabled around 06:45[/b]. Additionally, comprehensive maintenance and backup of the account database will be performed. Please notice that the maintenance time may change based on specific work conditions. We kindly ask all players to plan the game time accordingly.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]\[New Content][/b] [/p][p]1 .Battle Pass Update:[/p][list][*][p]Battle Pass Rewards: Includes 2 swimsuit skins for Godfrey's inheritance Ada and Octavia with matching primary/secondary weapons/shields, 4 soldier skins for Dian Wei, Liu Bei, Hattori Hanzo, and Mochizuki Chiyome, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Soldier Skin Returns: 24 selectable soldier skins, including 6 popular skins voted by players and 18 others.[/p][/*][/list][p]2 .New "Gameplay Lab" event is now available. Players can access it via "Normal Mode - Entertainment Mode". This event will feature the "Tactics System", available every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday from 19:00 to 22:00.[/p][p]a. Tactics System: Reclassified based on hero and army characteristics, with each hero type having its own selectable and equippable tactics library.[/p][list][*][p]Hero classifications (viewable in hero info):[/p][olist][*][p]Snipers: Mid/short-range archers like Huang Yueying, Xiao Qiao, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Marksmen: Long-range archers like Sun Shangxiang, Zhen Ji, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Shield Guards: Shield infantry like Ling Tong, Diao Chan, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Pikemen: Spear infantry with anti-cavalry skills like Zhang Fei, Joan of Arc, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Guards: Non-shield infantry without anti-cavalry skills like Qin Qiong, Bai Qi, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Rangers: Stealth/ranged infantry like Zhurong, Hattori Hanzo, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Lancers: Cavalry with charge skills like Zhao Yun, Ma Chao, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Raiders: Cavalry without charge skills like Xiahou Yuan, Guan Yu, etc.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]Three tactic types: Hero-only, Soldier-only, and Army-wide. Hover for details.[/p][/*][*][p]Each hero has 100 tactic points limit. notes.title: "Blood of Steel" Version Update Announcement – May 22nd
notes.content:
To ensure the game's stability and enhance overall service quality and user experience, "Blood of Steel" will undergo maintenance on May 22nd from 08:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). During this period, the game world will be temporarily closed, and game matchmaking will be disabled around 07:45. Additionally, comprehensive maintenance and backup of the account database will be performed. Please notice that the maintenance time may change based on specific work conditions. We kindly ask all players to plan the game time accordingly.

[b]Update Content[/b]

1. Limited-Time Collection Skin Blind Box [Elven Dream] Now Available:
[list]
[*] This season's rewards include Collection Sets for five Heroes: Helen, Victoria, Lagertha, Zoe I, and Cleopatra. Each set contains the Hero Skin, Main Weapon, Secondary Weapon, Shield, and Cloak. Additional rewards include Tough Steel, Cute Silk, Battle Pass Tokens, and Skin Shards.
[*] The [Elven Dream] Blind box has a permanent purchase limit of 120 draws. Upon reaching 120 draws, you are guaranteed to obtain all rewards from the box.
[*] Guaranteed rewards at milestone draws: At 20, 40, 60, and 80 draws: Receive 1x [Elven Dream Choice Box], allowing you to select one Collection Skin for Victoria, Lagertha, Zoe I, or Cleopatra. At 50, 70, 90, 100, and 120 draws: Receive Orange-grade Collection Helen Set (includes Cloak, Trojan Horse Mount Skin, Shield, Main Weapon, Hero Skin & Pet).
[*] Collect the full contents of one [Elven Dream] Set to unlock the Hero's Animated Half-Length Portrait. Collect all five sets to unlock the [Elven Dream Avatar] for your Player profile, claimable in the loot box interface.
[*] You can access the loot box from Store > Skins > Collection Blind Box and use Awakening Points to draw.
[*] The [Elven Dream] Blind Box will be available until June 26.
[/list]
2. 8th Anniversary Celebration Event Now Live for a Limited Time! Join the festivities and earn a treasure trove of rewards, including: Lyu Bu inherited Hero Lyu Lingqi. Helen’s exclusive Golden Shinning Stone: “Poetry of moon dust's lament”. The first-ever Animated Background Display: “Fantasy Tree Spirit”. Brand-new Animated Loading Illustration: “Fantasy Forest Spirit”. Limited-Time Avatar Frame. Popular Soldier Skins and many more valuable rewards!

3. Exclusive Contract [Eternal Strife] Event Preview Now Available — Advanced Signing Opens After June 5 Maintenance!
[list]
[*] After the June 5 maintenance, opening a BSL2025 Tournament Chest will grant Silver Coins*1000. If you've unlocked the full version of Bos Plus, you’ll also receive [2025 BSL Proof of Contract*1]. The BSL2025 Tournament Chest can be obtained via livestream gift codes or tournament cheer events.
[*] This limited-time contract supports Advanced Signing only. Use [2025 BSL Proof of Contract] and [Limited-Time Contract Key] to sign and claim rewards from the exclusive contract pool.
[*] Featured weapons in this contract series come with: All-new trajectory visuals. Unique activation states. Custom execution animations. Personalized finisher effects. Exclusive idle animations
[*] This contract is exclusive to the tournament event and does not affect the drop rate or availability of regular contract chests.
[/list]
4. Wu Zetian added to Awakening Exchange and can be redeemed using Awakening Diamonds

5. High-Energy Moments enabled in Legion War (excluding 5V5 Ranked Practice) and Siege Battles

6. Optimized Zhang Bao’s charge rules

7. Fixed a bug where Lady Zhurong’s hounds would bite into the air under certain conditions

8. Fixed a bug where Diao Chan’s legion would freeze far from enemies when using [Shield Rush]

9. Fixed unstable breacher damage in Himeji Castle and Bad Hombury maps.

10. Fixed a bug where breachers displaced by Napoleon’s cannons would not return to attack points in Himeji Castle and Bad Hombury maps.

11. Fixed abnormal model display when Boudica uses “Lingxi Heavenly Witch” or “Youyuan Night Witch” skins while moving

12. Fixed lag caused by using real-time voice

13. Restored the ability to download other players’ replays

    ● The seasonal purchase limits in the “Customization Items” and “Other Items” categories of the War Order Store will be refreshed with this version update.

5、 The limited-time "Heroes Unleashed" is now live! Players can obtain the permanent Hero Wu Zetian or receive 78000 Silver through the event.Additionally, the "Anniversary Battle Pass Soldier Skin Voting Event" has officially begun! Players can vote daily for their favorite Battle Pass Legion Skins. The top 8 ranked skins will return during the Anniversary Celebration Event!

6、 In Path of Awakening – Point Awakening – Skin Selection Box and Weapon Selection Box, a new Isabella Skin "Princess Chenxi" has been added, along with her matching primary and secondary weapons and shield.

7、 The "Highlight Moment Camera" for Legion War Ranked Mode has been re-enabled after optimization:
    ● The new version of Highlight Moments will no longer play automatically after battle. Instead, a popup will appear in the lower-right corner of the post-battle results screen—interested Players can click to view it.
    ● Playback duration for Highlight Moments will dynamically adjust based on Player performance.

8、 Hero Arena now supports Replay Playback functionality.

9、 Open World – Conquer the World and Solo Ranked Mode seasons have concluded and are now restarted.

10、 Open World Battle Pass has been updated.

[b][Adjustments & Optimizations][/b]

1. Hero Balance Adjustments:

    a) Zhang Bao / Zhang Xingcai:
    ● Revised: Heroes now start with 100% initial focus points, which regenerates over time at a rate of 1% per second. Zhang Bao / Zhang Xingcai gain additional focus points by landing attacks or scoring kills.
    ● Skill [Shaft Charge] adjustment: Now consumes 60% Focus points to activate. For 15 seconds after charging, damage taken is reduced by 25%. Upon colliding with enemies, a Spear Strike is triggered, dealing heavy damage and knocking enemies down.
    ● Skill [Reinforcements] adjustment: Now consumes 40% Focus points to activate.
    ● Passive [Bloodbath] change: The effect that reduced [Shaft Charge] cooldown upon defeating enemies has been removed.
    ● New Z Skill: Intermediate equestrian skill – Summons a Steed, with a 180-second cooldown. While mounted, the Hero’s movement speed is reduced, and incoming damage is increased by 20%. While on horseback, the Hero can attack, defend, and use Legion Skills (some special skills are excluded), but deals 50% less damage and has a 10% attack speed penalty. When unmounted, press Z to summon the steed. When mounted, press Z to dismount.

    b) Trajan:
    ● Adjusted: Starts with 100% initial Focus Points, which regenerate over time. The entire unit restores 1.5% Focus Points for each enemy killed.
    ● Skill [Shield Rush] adjustment: Now consumes 60% Focus Points to activate.
    ● New Skill [Charge forward and throw spears]: Can only be used after a charge and consumes 20% Focus Points. The entire unit regains two Javelins and throws them toward the formation point. These javelins have a piercing effect.
    ● New Z Skill: Junior Riding Technique – Summons a personal Steed (only the Hero can mount), cooldown: 180 seconds. While mounted, the Hero’s movement speed is reduced, and damage taken increases by 20%. Attacking is disabled, and some Legion Skills cannot be used. Press Z to summon the steed when unmounted, and to dismount when mounted.

    c) Xiang Yu:
    ● Adjusted: Starts with 100% initial Focus Points, regenerates at 1% per second. Xiang Yu restores 3% Focus Points upon defeating an enemy.
    ● Skill [Deep Rserves] adjustment: Now consumes 80% Focus Points to activate.
    ● Skill [Intimidating Shout] adjustment: Xiang Yu’s melee damage increases by 40%, and his melee attacks knock down enemy soldiers.

    d) Yi Seong-gye:
    ● Skill [Herbal Mist]: Focus Point cost reduced to 40%.
    ● Skill [Poison Arrows]: Focus Point cost reduced to 70%, and now no longer interrupts basic attacks when used.
    ● Can now use Legion Skills while mounted.

    e) Amenut:
    ● Skill [Stealth]: Now increases ranged attack damage by 10% while in Stealth.
    ● Fixed a tooltip error in the Legion passive [Eyes of Zendar]; actual effect: Amunet's Legion deals bonus damage to enemies with less than 30% HP when using ranged attacks.

    f) Dian Wei:
    ● Reduced the amount of Rage gained through passive effects.

    g) Hattori Hanzo / Iga Oboro:
    ● New Effect [Weakness Attack]: While in Blade Storm state, Hattori Hanzo / Iga Oboro and their Legion deal 50% bonus damage when hitting the enemy's back or head with melee attacks.
    ● Legion passive adjustment: Bonus damage from back attacks reduced to 15%.
    ● Added new Legion passive effect: When Hattori Hanzo / Iga Oboro and their Legion land melee attacks on the enemy's back or head, they restore 15% of the damage dealt as HP (up to a maximum of 30 HP).

    h) Napoleon:
    ● Increased Legion base defense.
    ● Expanded medium damage radius for Cannons.
    ● New Z Skill: Junior Riding Technique – Summons a personal Steed (only the Hero can mount), cooldown: 180 seconds. While mounted, the Hero’s movement speed is reduced, and incoming damage increases by 20%. Cannot attack or use some Legion Skills while mounted. Press Z to summon when unmounted, and to dismount when mounted.

    i) Octavian:
    ● Reduced the damage dealt by soldiers produced from Military Tent.
    ● Decreased the HP of Military Tent.

    j) Deng Ai:
    ● Adjusted: Starts with 100% initial Focus Points, which regenerate at 1% per second. The Hero gains 0.2% Focus Points whenever the Legion hits an enemy with a ranged attack.
    ● Skill [Sprint] adjustment: Now consumes 80% Focus Points. Greatly increases Deng Ai and his Legion’s mount speed, reduces melee damage taken by 20% and ranged damage taken by 35%. While active, melee attacks to enemy heads or backs deal 50% bonus damage for 30 seconds.
    ● Reduced the bonus damage effect from back attacks in Deng Ai's passive abilities.

    k) Bathory:
    ● Adjusted: Starts with 100% initial Focus Points, which regenerate over time. Gains 10% Focus Points for each enemy killed using [Manual Lance].
    ● Skill [Winged Charge] adjustment: Now consumes 70% Focus Points. Also increases mount's minimum starting speed and overall movement speed.

    l) Aguda:
    ● Skill [Iron Buddha] duration reduced from 25 seconds to 20 seconds.

    m) Catherine:
    ● Catherine’s Material value has been replaced with Focus Points. She now starts with 100% Focus Points, regenerating at 1% per second.
    ● Removed passive effects that granted Supply Value on hit/kill. Now, when Catherine approaches and picks up [Loot], she gains 25% Focus Points.
    ● [Plundered Provisions] is now a passive skill, consuming 30% Focus Points to activate.
    ● [Plundered Ammunition] is now a passive skill, consuming 25% Focus Points to activate.

    n) Fan Lihua:
    ● Adjusted: Starts with 100% initial Focus Points, which regenerate over time. When [Flying Claw] hits and successfully pulls an enemy Soldier or Hero, she gains 4% or 8% Focus Points respectively.
    ● Skill [Forced Gallop] further increases mounted movement speed. Cooldown reduced from 120 seconds to 90 seconds.
    ● Skill [Throwing Flying Claw] adjustment: Now consumes 80% Focus Points to activate.

    o) Agrippina:
    ● Removed the attack speed bonus from the [Courage] state.
    ● Reduced the HP restoration provided by the [Heal] state.

    p) Saladin:
    ● Skill [Sword of Truth]: Grants the Blessing effect upon activation. (Blessing: Reduces damage taken by the entire Legion by 20%, and increases mount impact force by 50%.)

    q) Huang Zhong / Huang Wudie:
    ● Increased HP for mounts and soldiers.

    r) Temujin:
    ● Reduced the armor of Temujin’s Legion.
    ● Decreased the ranged accuracy of Temujin’s soldiers while moving on horseback.

    s) Xiahou Yuan:
    ● Adjusted: Starts with 100% initial Focus Points, which regenerate at 1% per second. Gains 1.2% Focus Points for each mounted shot that hits an enemy, and 2.4% for each kill.
    ● Skill [Poison Arrow] adjustment: Now consumes 75% Focus Points to activate.
    ● Increased HP for mounts and soldiers.

    t) Sibylla:
    ● Adjusted: Starts with 100% initial Focus Points, regenerating at 1% per second. While [Sniper Formation] is active, Sibylla gains 2% Focus Points for each enemy killed by the unit.
    ● Removed Skill: [Quick Reload].
    ● New Skill: [Burst arrow] – Can only be activated during [Sniper Formation] and consumes 80% Focus Points. Fires from a crouching camel, losing piercing ability but gaining the Explosive effect for 20 seconds. (Explosive: Arrows create a 2-meter radius explosion on impact, damaging up to 8 enemies.)
    ● Increased soldier crouching speed.
    ● Increased soldier HP.

    u) Helen:
    ● Added passive Focus regeneration: 1% Focus Points per second. When Helen is near the Wooden Horse, regeneration increases to 2% per second.
    ● Skill [Throw Spear] Focus cost adjusted to 45%.
    ● Legion passive: Damage reduction for Helen and her Legion near the Wooden Horse increased to 20%.

    v) Victoria:
    ● Slightly increased Rage gain when soldiers are hit.
    ● Increased overall Legion armor and shield HP.

    w) Cleopatra:
    ● Q Skill [Bless of Isis] adjustment: Immediately restores 200 HP, increases both inner and outer armor by 20, and boosts walking speed by 1 m/s for 25 seconds.

2. Base combat mechanics further adjusted and optimized:
    a) Horsemanship Revamp – Now split into Basic and Intermediate levels:

    ● Junior Riding Technique: Summons a Steed with a 180-second cooldown. While mounted, the Hero’s movement speed is reduced and incoming damage is increased by 20%. Cannot attack or defend while mounted but can use Legion Skills (some special skills excluded). Press Z to summon the steed when unmounted; press Z again while mounted to dismount.

    ● Intermediate equestrian skill: Summons a Steed with a 180-second cooldown. While mounted, the Hero’s movement speed is reduced and incoming damage is increased by 20%. Can attack and defend while mounted, and use Legion Skills (some special skills excluded). However, attacks deal 50% reduced damage and attack speed is decreased by 10%. Press Z to summon when unmounted; press Z again to dismount.

    b) Unified Ranged Damage Falloff System:
    ● Longbows and Heavy Crossbows: No damage falloff within 15 meters. From 15 to 125 meters, damage falloff increases gradually, up to a maximum of 20%. Beyond 125 meters, maintains the maximum 20% damage reduction.
    ● Recurve Bows, Light Crossbows, Triple Shot Crossbows, and Sling Rods: No damage falloff within 15 meters. From 15 to 125 meters, damage falloff increases gradually, up to a maximum of 30%. Beyond 125 meters, maintains the maximum 30% damage reduction.
    ● Repeating Crossbows, Scatter Crossbows, and Javelins: No damage falloff within 15 meters. From 15 to 125 meters, damage falloff increases gradually, up to a maximum of 40%. Beyond 125 meters, maintains the maximum 40% damage reduction.
    ● Throwing Knives, Throwing Axes, and Throwing Hammers: No damage falloff within 15 meters. From 15 to 100 meters, damage falloff increases gradually, up to a maximum of 50%. Beyond 100 meters, maintains the maximum 50% damage reduction.
    ● Muskets: No damage falloff within 15 meters. From 15 to 100 meters, damage falloff increases gradually, up to a maximum of 90%. Beyond 100 meters, maintains the maximum 90% damage reduction.

3. Voice Chat System Optimization:
    a) All Players can now speak simultaneously during battles.
    b) Added Squad Voice Chat and Team Voice Chat:
    ● Squad Voice Chat: Available when in a pre-made squad. Hold Caps Lock to communicate within your squad.
    ● Team Voice Chat: Available at all times. Hold V to speak with all allied Players.
    c) A new Voice Volume setting has been added under “Settings – Audio Settings,” allowing Players to adjust the voice chat volume.

3. Replay System Enhancements:
    a) Improved the barrage message experience: Quick-sending is now available without needing to open the control panel with the N key.
    b) Optimized static camera positions at points A, B, and C in replays for a better viewing experience.
    c) Reduced loading time when entering replays.

4. Luoyang Map Visual Overhaul:
    a) The Luoyang map has received a full visual update to enhance immersion and performance.

5. Marketplace – Minimum Listing Price Adjustments for Contract Items:
    a) Purple Quality: Minimum price set to 1,000 YP.
    b) Red Quality: Minimum price set to 10,000 YP.
    c) Gold Quality: Minimum price set to 50,000 YP.

6. Marketplace Interface Optimization:
    a) Improved UI and browsing experience for more efficient trading.

7. Bos PLUS Interface Update:
    a) Added detailed drop rate descriptions for past Tokens of Contract events.

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]

1. Fixed an issue where the main weapon of Sibylla’s Witch Set was not displayed in the equipment list.
2. Fixed a bug where trial Heroes could not use Large Bandages.
3. Fixed a display issue where skins from the Heavenly Goddess Blind Box series showed incorrect names on the matchmaking loading screen.
4. Fixed a bug with Lady Zhurong’s Heart-seeking Noble Set where the wing position was incorrect.
5. Fixed an issue where some expired items could not be recycled from the inventory.
6. Fixed an incorrect source display for Zhao Yun’s skin “Thief Kidd.”
7. Fixed terrain sinking issues in certain areas of Gallia.
8. Fixed abnormal positioning of the “Linglong Nine Tails” accessory for Da Qiao.
9. Fixed a bug where Alexander, when using [Spear Charge] on horseback, would trigger visual effects from Zhao Manying's Shinning Stone.
10. Fixed an issue where Horsemanship Skills would interrupt the end lag of attack animations.

 [/list]

[New Content]

1、Limited-Time Event: Legends of Mystical Collector Skin Blind Box:
[list]
[*] Rewards include collector sets for Da Qiao, Huang Yueying, Yu Ji, Zhen Ji, and Diao Chan. Each set contains a Hero Skin, primary weapon, secondary weapon, shield, pet, and accessories. Additional rewards include Tough Steel, Cute Silk, Battle Pass Tokens, and Skin Shards.

[*] At 20, 40, 60, and 80 draws, players will receive a [Legends of Mystical Skin Selection Box]. Each box allows players to select one collector skin for Huang Yueying, Yu Ji, Zhen Ji, or Diao Chan. At 50, 70, 90, 100, and 120 draws, players are guaranteed an Orange Collector Quality Da Qiao Set, which includes her pet, primary weapon, secondary weapon, accessory (tail), and Hero Skin.
[*] [Legends of Mystical] skins allow customization of accessories such as ears, tails, and special effects.
[*] Completing a full set of [Legends of Mystical] skins for any Hero unlocks a dynamic half-body loading portrait for that Hero. Collecting all five sets grants an exclusive [Legends of Mystical Avatar], which can be claimed directly from the blind box interface.
[*] Access the blind box event via the Mall > Skins > Collection Blind Box tab. Players can use Credits to participate in the draws.
[*] The current [Legends of Mystical] Blind Box sale will end on February 25th.
[/list]
2、New Contract Weapon Series: "Eternal Soul of War":
[list]
[*] After purchasing Iron Armor Plus, Players have a 30% chance to obtain the current Token of Contract ("Eternal Soul of War") as a reward after battle settlement, with a weekly limit of 2 drops. Previous Tokens of Contract will now be rare drops.
[*] This Season's Epic Red Contract Weapon [Battle Soul] Series: Features brand-new trajectory lines, weapon activation states, custom slash actions, custom end special effects, and unique idle animations.
[*] Rare Purple Contract Weapons, added new trajectory line effects for enhanced visuals.
[*] Legendary Reward [Mysterious Chest] now includes a new footprint effect "Leap Shadow Clear."
[*] In this contract, Players can consume Silver to obtain a “Contract Key” for “Ordinary Signing” or spend YP to purchase an “Advanced Contract Key” for “Advanced Signing” to obtain general-purpose weapons and other items. When signing with an “Advanced Contract Key”, the probability of obtaining general-purpose weapons of high quality or above will significantly increase, and [War Soul Immortal] used for contract revisions will no longer be obtained.
[/list]
3、New Game Mode "Grab and against the beach" Now Live. Players can access the new event via “Normal Mode - Entertainment Mode”. This event is a Stronghold Capture Battle, where both sides unlock the opponent's flag and score points by occupying strongholds. The first to reach 2000 points wins. During the event, players can experience soldier line engagements, interactions between supply units and Guardsmen, mid-lane clashes, and various supply boosts. Event Schedule:
[list]
[*] Monday, Wednesday, Friday, Sunday: 19:00–21:00
[*] Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday: 14:00–16:00
[/list]
4、Ranked Match (updated maps), Territory War, and Elite Contest seasons will conclude, and a new season will begin. The rewards for the new season "The Song of Seven" Ranked Match have been adjusted to bound Universal Weapons (Ranked-exclusive, non-tradeable, and cannot be used for Covenant Revision).
[list]
[*] King/Emperor can obtain: Universal Weapon Two-Handed Sword - The Gate of Heaven (Bound) & Sea Moon Leisure (Bound)
[*] Marquis/Duke can obtain: Universal Weapon Two-Handed Sword - Sea Moon Leisure (Bound)
[/list]
5、Battle Pass Updates:
[list]
[*] Battle Pass Rewards: Includes the Robin Hood Inherited Hero - Marian, two new Bu Lianshi Hero Skins with matching primary and secondary weapons, and four new Soldier Skins for Qin Qiong, Li Yuanba, Germanicus, and Agrippina.
[*] Advanced Contract Key reward added to the Advanced Battlepass. Players can claim it after purchasing.
[*] New Upgrade Battle Pass feature: After purchasing the Normal Battlepass, players can upgrade to the Advanced Battlepass using corresponding tokens.
[*] Returning Soldier Skins: A selection of 26 Soldier Skins will be available, including six popular skins chosen by Players' Votes and 20 other soldier skins.
[*] In the Battle Pass Shop, the seasonal purchase limits for "Personalized Props" and "Other Products" will be refreshed after the version update.
[/list]
6、New Red Pyroxenes for Joan and Fan Lihua Introduced via Spring Festival Event:
[list]

[list]
[*] Step key: Alt key

[/list]

[list]
[*] Step key: Shift key
[*] Zoom: Hold/Release the Alt key

Minor violations will result in temporary matchmaking restrictions, while severe violations may lead to bans from ranked matches or competitive play, and in extreme cases, permanent account bans.

Among these, the "Yangzhou Town Night 5V5" map has been added to the ranked match map pool.

The [Queen's War Preparation Blind Box Avatar] will be distributed via email within 3 business days after the version update.

[*] Adjusted the activity points obtained from some tasks.

[/list]

[list]
[*] When replacing the Contract Token, the corresponding currency icon is also updated.
[*] Empty slots for Contract Revisions now have a "+" button to directly redirect to the Marketplace.
[*] Added a Contract Item Collection Room.
[*] The Effect Customization list is now unfolded by default.
[*] Introduced a trial feature for Universal Weapons.
[*] Added probability display for certain items or actions.
[*] Purple-grade weapons now include a Kill Counter feature.
[/list]
[Bug Fixes]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where Xiao Qiao's bow skin [Eglomise Bow] displayed arrows in the wrong direction when drawing the bow.
[*] Fixed a bug where Frederick I's finishing move after a charge could occasionally fail to activate.
[*] Fixed a bug where Octavian's Military Tent could capture flag points.
[*] Fixed an issue on the Lu Ban's Academy map where constructed siege engines were not displayed.
[*] Fixed the issue where the Hero Library proficiency sorting was incorrect after enabling the Iron Armor Plus feature.
 [/olist]

At 50th, 70th, 90th, 100th, and 120th draws, you will receive the Orange Collectible Quality Roxana Set Rewards (Shield, Secondary Weapon, Mount, Primary Weapon, Hero Skin).

2、Hidden Treasure Skins: Sabbat Witch - Bathory, Blood Dracula - Baldwin I, and Blood Lilith - Stephanie will be removed after the maintenance on November 28.

4、Hero Balance Adjustments:

Da Qiao:

Margaret:

notes.title: "Blood of Steel" Version Update Announcement – November 14th
notes.content:
To ensure the game's stability and enhance overall service quality and user experience, "Blood of Steel" will undergo maintenance on November 14th from 08:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). During this period, the game world will be temporarily closed, and game matchmaking will be disabled around 07:45. Additionally, comprehensive maintenance and backup of the account database will be performed. Please notice that the maintenance time may change based on specific work conditions. We kindly ask all players to plan the game time accordingly.
　　Update Details:

1、Official Launch of the 2024 Mount & Blade Festival:

a. Team Up without Losing Stars:
[list]
[*] Event Duration: After maintenance on November 14 - November 20 at 10:00
[*] During the event, teams of two or more Players participating in Ranked Legion War/Ranked Siege can enjoy up to 3 instances of star protection upon defeat.
[*] Star protection counts are shared across both Ranked Legion War and Ranked Siege modes.
[*] If the player has selected the BoS Plus Star Protection function, the count of the event will be used first, and the count from Bos Plus will not be consumed.
[/list]

b. Limited-Time Free Heroes & Double Rewards:
[list]
[*] Event Duration: After maintenance on November 14 - November 20 at 10:00
[*] During the event, all direct-sale Heroes are available for free, allowing Players to experience them across all modes. Full Hero experience points are awarded during this free period (Inherited Heroes are excluded).
[*] During the event, participate in battles to earn double Hero experience, double monarch experience, and double Silver Coin rewards. These double rewards can stack with bonuses from Hero skins and other multipliers.
[/list]

c. Login Rewards, Double Bonuses on Top-Ups and Spending:
[list]
[*] Event Duration: After maintenance on November 14 - December 11 at 23:59
[*] Throughout the event, log in daily to receive free event perks such as the [M& B Avatar]. A single recharge unlocks the Supreme Login Gift, including additional rewards like the [M& B Headframe].
[*] Accumulate specific amounts of top-ups or spending to receive rewards such as [M&B Loading Image], Heart of Inherit, World Fragments, and more.
[/list]

d. Mount & Blade Puzzle Event:
[list]
[*] Event Duration: After maintenance on November 14 - December 11 at 23:59
[*] During the event, complete specified tasks to earn opportunities to draw puzzle pieces. Collect all pieces to unlock corresponding rewards.
[*] A maximum of 75 draws guarantees the full puzzle rewards, including the [Self-Selected Valuables Chest] and the new Zhao Yun Skin [Thief Kidd].
[*] Each puzzle piece draw awards one Mount & Blade Festival Gold Coin. Duplicate puzzle pieces are automatically converted to one Mount & Blade Festival Gold Coin. These coins can be exchanged for various rewards in the Mount & Blade Festival Mall.
[/list]

2、New Siege Map “Zeelandia” Now Available. Additionally, a "New Map Preview" event will be held, where Players will have a 100% chance to enter Zeelandia during the designated times:
[list]
[*] a. Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays, and Sundays from 19:00 to 21:00
[*] b. Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays from 14:00 to 16:00
[/list]

3、Limited-Time Discounts on Popular Hero and Soldier Skins! Players can visit the Store - Featured section to purchase these special skin bundles, which include the complete set (main weapon, secondary weapon, and more) for each skin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/2d8ad025d077702b254ddfe444ca3fcd560e2718.png[/img]

4、The Mystery Treasure Chest has been updated with exclusive limited skins, including: Sabbat Witch (Bathory), Blood Dracula (Baldwin I), Blood Lilith (Stephanie).

5、Fixed a bug causing Block and Counter to inflict 1 point of damage on the player.

6、Resolved an issue where Xiao Qiao’s Q Skill would lose its flaming arrow effect if used at the moment of firing an arrow.

7、Fixed an abnormal damage issue with Frederick I’s horse charge.

8、Corrected the insufficient enemy count in the Open World Campaign stages 2-3.

notes.title: "Blood of Steel" Version Update Announcement – October 31th
notes.content:
To ensure the game's stability and enhance overall service quality and user experience, "Blood of Steel" will undergo maintenance on October 31th from 09:00 to 13:00 (UTC+8). During this period, the game world will be temporarily closed, and game matchmaking will be disabled around 08:45. Additionally, comprehensive maintenance and backup of the account database will be performed. Please notice that the maintenance time may change based on specific work conditions. We kindly ask all players to plan the game time accordingly.

[New Content]

1、New Hero Octavian has been officially released.

2、Battlepass Double Reduction Upgrade:
[list]
[*] Battlepass Availability: The Battle Pass will be available from October 31, 2024, after maintenance, until January 19, 2025, lasting for 12 weeks.
[*] ※ Due to adjustments in upcoming versions, the Battle Pass schedule has been specially modified. We will compensate affected players with the 13th week's experience at the end of the season. Please stay tuned for further announcements regarding the compensation details.
[*] After maintenance, the consumption progress of Battle Pass Tokens and the season purchase limits in the Battle Pass Shop will be reset. Battle Pass Tokens, Soldier Skin Exchange Coupons, and Avatar Box Exchange Coupons will not be affected.
[*] Battle Pass Price Adjustment: The price of the Normal Battlepass has been adjusted to 4500 YP.
[*] Battlepass Task Streamlining: Removed and adjusted some tasks that players reported as difficult to complete, and increased the number of task refreshes from 8 to 20.
[*] Weekly Experience Accumulation: Any unearned weekly task experience will accumulate at a 50% rate, with a maximum storage of 40,000 experience. After purchasing any battle pass and reaching the "Weekly Task Experience" cap, Players can continue to gain experience from the accumulated experience pool by completing tasks. 
[*] Battlepass Rewards: Zhao Yun's inherited Hero Zhao Manying, Inahime Hero Skin with matching main and secondary weapons, and 4 Soldier Skins. Players who purchase the Advanced Battlepass will instantly advance by 30 tiers and receive additional rewards, including Linglong Silk x5, Soldier Skin Exchange Coupon, and Avatar Box Exchange Coupon. (Players can redeem these in the Battlepass Shop, with a new avatar frame, [Shacheng silhouette avatar], added this season.)
[*] Soldier Skins Return: 30 Soldier Skins available for selection, including 6 popular Soldier Skins chosen by Player votes and 24 additional Soldier Skins.
[/list]

3、Rank-legion (Map Change), Territory War, and Elite Contest season will conclude, and a new season will begin.

4、Season Shop: The current season shop will open the exchange for two Melisende Skins: [Tidal Wrath] and [Oceanic Fury]. Additionally, the previous season shop will now include a self-selected accessory chest and the exchange of some Hero components.

5、The limited-time awaken event "Phoenix comes with grace" will be removed, and the Hua Mulan Awakening Set will be added to the Awaking Store and available for crystal exchange. The exchange includes the complete Hua Mulan Awakening skin set (with Taunt Emotes and chat emotes, but excludes red skill Shining Stones, and the exclusive skin sets for the Heroes Huang Wudie, Cai Wenji, Bu Lianshi, and Liang Hongyu, as well as their Soldier Skins).

6、Rank-legion will introduce new features “Hero Preference Display” and “Hero Selection Filter”: 
[list]
[*] Hero Preference Display: In the Rank-legion interface, Players can edit their preferred Heroes based on Hero usage rate, Hero win rate, or custom preferences. During the ban phase, this preference will be shown to your teammates. If a Player does not choose a Hero, the system will randomly select one, prioritizing the Player's preferred and available Heroes. 
[*] Hero Selection Filter: During the Hero selection phase, a new filter function will be added to the Hero list, allowing Players to sort Heroes by Hero usage rate, Hero win rate, and Hero mastery. This function can also be combined with the troop filter. 
[*] Hero usage rate and Hero win rate will be calculated and displayed based on data from the most recent 100 battles (including Legion War and Rank-legion).
[/list]

7、Roxana Inherit is now available: Inherit Point is 150, and can be achieved by consuming Valuable Items or Stardust Tokens, or directly purchased for 4,800 YC Points.

8、The Profits Store has rotated and replaced the available skins for exchange.

9、Open World modes Conquer the World and Solo Rank will conclude and reopen. The season rewards for Conquer the World and Solo Rank have been updated to the cloak [The radiance of Austerlitz – Napoleon].

10、Open World Battlepass has been updated.

[Adjustments and Optimizations]

1、Hero Balance Adjustments:

a. Zhao Yun:
● Added a Rage mechanic: While in combat, Zhao Yun gains 4% Rage per second. If moving at high speed, Rage gain increases to 6%. When Rage is full, Zhao Yun enters Gentian state (Gentian: Reduces all damage taken by Zhao Yun and his mount by 25%, and increases damage dealt to mounts by 100%. Immediately resets Q skill [Crouch Lance], and reduces its cooldown by 25 seconds after use. Gentian state lasts for 20 seconds, during which no more Rage can be accumulated).
● The active skill [Assault] has been adjusted to: Increase the speed of all mounted units, reduce all damage taken by 25%, and increase Impact by 100% for 30 seconds.
● The skill [Dilu] now includes: Restores full HP to soldiers' mounts.
       
b. Bai Qi:
● Removed abilities: [Square Formation], [Toggle Spear-Hook]
● Added ability: [Hook Formation]: Orders the army to form a Hook Formation at a designated point. In this formation, soldiers take 15% less damage and use hook attacks (Hook attacks cannot be interrupted by enemy attacks or defense; they deal damage to enemies, dismount cavalry, and knock down infantry).
● Added ability: [Meritorious Title]: Consumes 60% Focus to activate. Reduces damage taken by the army by 15% for 15 seconds. During this time, the Hero's attack speed increases by 6%, and each enemy killed restores 30 HP to the entire army.
● Ability [Projection]: Focus cost reduced to 25%.
● Passive enhancement: Bai Qi now gains additional Focus when landing Melee Attacks or defeating enemies.
         
c. Liang Hongyu:
● Added ability: [Explosive Flames]: Liang Hongyu throws multiple firecrackers forward, knocking down enemy soldiers (knocks back Heroes) and reducing their movement speed for 6 seconds.
● Ability [Oil Arrow]: Focus cost reduced to 40%.

d. Caesar:
● Reduced the amount of Focus Caesar's unit recovers when attacked.

e. Zhang Bao:
● Increased the number of enemies that can be hit when using the Q ability [Crouch Lance] and improved the flexibility of turning during attacks.

f. Joan of Arc:
● Unit passive effect: When Joan or her troops defeat enemies, the cooldown of [Bless] is reduced by 4 or 2 seconds.
       
g. Baldwin I:
● Ability [Frenzy]: Now grants a shield that absorbs 60 damage.
● Ability [Echelon Formation]: The defense reduction effect has been changed to an attack reduction effect.

h. Frederick I:
● Added a Blue Armor mechanic.
● Adjusted the turning speed during charges.
● Fixed a bug where troops' shutdown move hit-points were inaccurate after charging.
● Ability [Impact]: Now consumes 80% Focus to activate.
● Shutdown move [Heroic Charge]: Added slash damage reduction.

i. Kaihime:
● When Rage reaches 100%, the cooldown of the ability [Hell March] is reduced from 10 seconds to 8 seconds.
● Legion passive [Hojo's Will] adjustment: When Kaihime defeats an enemy, the cooldown of [Soul Bond] is reduced by 3 seconds.

j. Lagartha:
● Ability [Toggle Shield-Wall] adjustment: When activating Odyn's Fury, soldiers in the Toggle Shield-Wall formation will only gain the [Knock Back] effect on their shield defense.
● Activating [Odyn's Fury] will restore broken shields and increase the health cap of the Hero and soldiers. The values have been reduced from 240|120 to 160|80.
k. Trajan:
● Increased the damage of single spear throws.
● The cooldown of the ability [Shield Rush] has been reduced from 120 seconds to 60 seconds.

l. Da Qiao:
● The effect of the [Oil Pot] explosion is now: After the explosion, it knocks down all enemies within range and deals damage. Explosion damage increases by 50%|100%|150% based on the number of [Sear] effect.
● The Hero's passive effect has been adjusted: After using [Fire Spray], no Focus will be recovered for 2 seconds.

m. Helen:
● Increased unit defense.
● Increased the damage of soldiers' single spear throws.
● Increased Hero's spear throw attack speed but reduced its damage.

n. Margaret:
● Increased Margaret's Rapid Throw speed.
● Ability [Stone throwing machine] has been adjusted: Each shot now launches a fire oil bomb that explodes on impact, creating a burning fire circle at the landing point, lasting for 12 seconds. Hero skills and unit passive abilities have been adjusted to replenish fire oil bombs.

o. Meng Huo:
● Adjusted the elephant's normal attack so it no longer consumes stamina.
● The attack path of the elephant's normal attack has been adjusted to ensure that charges and normal attacks do not interfere with each other, preventing damage loss.

p. Huang Zhong/Huang Wudie:
● Adjustment: The Hero now starts with 100% initial Focus, and Focus regenerates over time at a rate of 1% per second.
● Unit passive effect adjustment: When Huang Zhong/Huang Wudie hit or defeat enemy units with mounted archery, they gain 2%|4% Focus. The cooldown of [Rapid Shot] is reduced by 3|10 seconds.
● Ability [Quick Projectile] adjustment: Consumes 30% Focus for each use.
        
q. Spartacus:
● The Hero now starts with 50% initial supplies.
● Added an out-of-combat health regeneration mechanic.
● The cooldown of the ability [Fishing Nets] has been reduced from 150 seconds to 90 seconds.

r. Han Xin:
● Increased Focus recovery rate: From 0.5% per second to 0.8% per second.
● The Focus provided by the ability [Point General] has been reduced.

s. Zhuge Liang:
● The duration of the ability [Daoist Magic] has been adjusted to 15 seconds.

t. Hattori Hanzo:
● Added a Focus system, with Hanzo's Focus recovering at a rate of 1% per second.
● Ability [Assault] adjustment: Consumes 20% Focus per use, and the duration is reduced to 15 seconds.
● Ability [Blade Rush] adjustment: Consumes 60% Focus per use.
● Fixed a bug where after using the Q ability [Blade Storm], Hanzo could continuously perform multiple slashes within 1.5 seconds.
● Renamed Heavy Attack basic moves as follows:
○ Quick Hand: Heavy attack + Heavy attack
○ Soul Slash: Light attack + Heavy attack

u. Mochizuki Chiyo:
● AI mechanics have been optimized. Upon switching, the Hero will remain stationary at the switch position (without moving toward the formation point), while soldiers will move toward the Hero.
● When switching back, if the Hero was in movement/retreat status, it will automatically change to follow status. When switching away, follow status will automatically change to stationary movement. If the Hero was in attack status, it will not change during the switch.
● Increased the armor of Mochizuki Chiyo's Unit.
● Activating the skill [Hide Yourself] now slightly increases movement speed.
● The cooldown of the skill [Psychic] has been reduced from 120 seconds to 90 seconds.

v. Xiahou Yuan:
● The cooldown of the ability [Sprint] has been reduced from 120 seconds to 60 seconds.

2、Optimizations for Formations Positioning, Weapon Mechanics, and Combat Operations:
[list]
[*] The Follow Formation has been adjusted to position the main Hero toward the middle or rear of the formation.
[*] Improved ground targeting operations for Projectile Shooting: When the mouse moves the target indicator circle, it will no longer be frequently obstructed by surface structures, allowing for smoother movement.
[*] Rolling and Sliding will no longer trigger combat status.
[*] Some Heroes' weapons have been enhanced with combo attacks for normal attacks. The affected Heroes and weapons are:
     ● One-Handed Sword: Ling Tong, Han Xin, Zhuge Liang, Liu Bei, Wang Yangming, Balian, Caesar, Alexander, Li Chenggui, Trajan, Huang Yueying, Sun Shangxiang, Diao Chan, Xiao Qiao, Zhen Mi, Isabella, Octavia, Inahime, Margaret, Roxana
     ● One-Handed Blade: Xiahou Yuan, Guan Yu, Huang Zhong, Bu Lianshi, Meng Huo, Sibilla, Stephanie, Bathory, Li Guang, Huang Wudie
     ● Long Spear: Zhang Fei
     ● Two-Handed Sword: Baldwin I, Cecilia
[*] For all weapons except dual-wielding weapons, the target count for upward slash attacks has been unified to 2 (those already targeting 2 remain unchanged), with the second target taking only 25% damage. The damage of enhanced normal attacks with upward slashes is increased by 10%.
[/list]
     
3、Mini-Map Optimizations:
[list]
[*] Added "Show Death Icon" and "Show Equipment Icon" options below the mini-map, both enabled by default after the update. Players can manually toggle these options to filter the displayed information according to their needs.
[*] Added an Equipment HUD to the field of view, displaying status (blue for allies, red for enemies, green when setup is complete) and distance, with synchronized status displayed on the mini-map.
[*] Added a destruction status to Stronghold points.
[*] Modified the large flag icon status: When a point is not yet open for capture, it will now display a "Locked" status; when the point is breached, the "Locked" status disappears.
[*] Improved the display effect of some icons and adjusted the display priority of mini-map icons.
[*] In Siege Battles, the mini-map now displays green Rally Troop points corresponding to the Player’s current location, visible only to the Player.
[*] In Siege Battles, when a point is contested, both sides will see relevant visual effect prompts in the interface UI.
[/list]

4、Reduced the wind speed in the Windy Map, decreasing the effect of wind on the deviation of Ranged Attacks.

5、The Yangzhou Town Map has been visually revamped (this includes related maps in the Yangzhou Town series, all of which have received visual updates).

6、Optimized the issue where forcefully closing the client during battlefield loading would prevent AI takeover and block players from being reported for intentional idling.

7、Optimized the weapon animation playback logic in the Hero interface, allowing players to quickly view the equipped weapon without waiting for the display animation to finish.

8、Added missing Command Voice Lines for some Heroes.

9、Added new animations for Arthur drawing his gun while mounted, and Huang Yueying drawing her sword.

[Bug Fixes]

1、Fixed a bug where the Amplify Damage debuff would incorrectly display after Ling Tong used his Q ability [Shield Charge].

2、Fixed a bug where no explosion damage numbers were displayed when Wang Yangming used his ability [Flying crow rocket].

3、Fixed a bug where Victoria's Taunt Emote could not be interrupted by movement.

4、Fixed a bug where Liang Hongyu's troops would have incorrect melee stances when switching using F4 during Alert Status.

5、Fixed a bug where the V-shaped crosshair was missing in the center of the screen when Liang Hongyu was not aiming.

6、Fixed a bug where Li Chenggui had no bow crosshair after switching to shooting mode and where extra hit effects were displayed on impact.

7、Fixed a bug where Kaihime's [Hell March] would significantly block and slow down cavalry.

8、Fixed a bug where Helen's attack sound would disappear while moving.

9、Fixed a bug where no footprint effects were shown when running left with a crossbow for the following Heroes: Huang Yueying, Zhen Ji, Liang Hongyu, Bu Lianshi, Da Qiao, Mary I, Amenut, Yu Ji, and Cecilia. Also fixed the same issue for Mochizuki Chiyo and Yu Ji when holding dual swords.

10、Fixed an issue where the following secondary weapon skins had no trailing effect when thrown: Hua Mulan's [Carbon Steel Physical Actuator] and [Ceramic Mandatory Booster], as well as Stephanie's [Lightning Bolt] and [Searing Light].

11、Fixed a clipping issue where female soldiers' heads and flags would overlap severely for some Heroes.

12、Fixed a bug where the braids were missing from Balian's Soldier Skins [Monitor of Holy City] and [Patroler of Holy City].

13、Fixed a bug where the hair color of Wang Yangming's and Koxinga's soldiers was inconsistent between in and out of battle.

14、Fixed a bug where some ground textures were missing in parts of Horns of Hattin and Xiliang.

15、Fixed a bug where the default cannon information and icon for Koxinga displayed incorrectly.

16、Fixed a bug where the voice lines for the Boudicca Soldier Skin [Moon Spirit Archer] were in Chinese instead of the correct language.

17、Fixed an issue where the "Beginner Benefits - Hero Discount" section incorrectly showed Koxinga costing 0 silver, but after redirecting to the mall, it showed the original price.

18、Fixed a bug on the Open World Babel Tower, Snowfield Hills Map where monsters would spawn but not move, preventing timely kills.

notes.content:
To ensure the game's stability and enhance overall service quality and user experience, "Blood of Steel" will undergo maintenance on September 26th from 09:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). During this period, the game world will be temporarily closed, and game matchmaking will be disabled around 08:45. We kindly ask all players to plan the game time accordingly.

Update Details:

1、Limited-Time Awakening Event: [Phoenix Comes With Grace] Now Available
[list]
[*] This event offers rewards including: the Hua Mulan Awaken Skin, Mulan Red Shinning Stone*3, exclusive skins for Huang Wudie, Cai Wenji, Bu Lianshi, and Liang Hongyu. Other rewards include a Self-Selected Skin Chest, Self-Selected Horse Chest, Self-Selected Weapon Chest, and Self-Selected Hero Chest. Players are limited to 240 draws, and all rewards are guaranteed after 240 draws.
[*] The 20th, 50th, and 85th draws will guarantee a [Phoenix Skin Selection Box]*1, allowing players to choose one exclusive skin for Cai Wenji, Bu Lianshi, or Liang Hongyu. The 30th, 65th, and 100th draws will reward a [Phoenix Soldier Self-Selection Box]*1, from which players can select a soldier skin for Cai Wenji, Bu Lianshi, or Liang Hongyu. At 140 draws, players will receive Huang Wudie’s Golden Exclusive Collection Set (Hero Skin, Main and Secondary Weapons, Accessories, Soldier Skin, and Horse). At 170 draws, players will obtain Hua Mulan Red Shinning Stone*3 (Fengchong Luanxiang; Chasing Moonlight; Bladed Fans - Frostbite Flying). After 240 draws, players will receive the Hua Mulan Red Awaken Set (Hero Skin, Main and Secondary Weapons, Winged Accessories, Soldiers, and Warhawk).
[*] All [Phoenix Comes With Grace] series Hero skins come with exclusive taunt actions. The Hua Mulan Awaken Skin features new visual effects, including the special action effect [Phoenix Dance Nine Days].
[*] Hua Mulan’s Awaken Main Weapon comes with an exclusive blade glow, "Cold Shadow," while Huang Wudie’s Exclusive Main and Secondary Weapons feature special effects: "Holding Fire" and " Floating Ashes."
[*] Collecting a complete set of [Phoenix Comes With Grace] skin will unlock a dynamic loading of half body Hero portrait. Collecting 5 sets from this series will grant the Player an additional portrait avatar: " Phoenix Comes With Grace Headframe."

[/list]

2、The "Apocalypse Indestructible Set" is now available in the “Mall - Promotion – Limited” section. The set includes the [Sword Shadows, Traces of Rainbow Light universal footstep effect (bound)]*3, [Apocalypse Indestructible Dynamic Avatar Frame], and [Apocalypse Eternal Radiance Loading Box], all obtainable using Awaken Crystals.

3、The National Day Web Event is live! Prepare for the Holiday Defense Battle:
[list]

[*] Event 2: Explosive Rebate, Incredible Returns 

From September 26 to October 24, accumulate recharges and spend to reach designated amounts and receive rewards such as the Golden Gift Chest, Open World War Pass Badges, Heart of Inherit, and the exclusive loading image "Initial chirping of phoenix."

[olist]

specifications).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/8d3d7926b6f8f0749942ffcaa644d520857c08c0.gif[/img]

 From September 26 to October 24, complete designated tasks to accumulate "Red Flags." 4、Optimized the HUD icons above soldiers' heads: Infantry icons are now dots, Archers are represented by parallelograms, and Cavalry by triangles.

notes.title: "Blood of Steel" Version Update Announcement – August 6th
notes.content:
To ensure the game's stability and enhance overall service quality and user experience, "Blood of Steel" will undergo maintenance on August 6th from 09:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). During this period, the game world will be temporarily closed, and game matchmaking will be disabled around 08:45. Update Content:

1、Optimized in-game lag issues and re-enabled the replay feature; replays created before the update will no longer be viewable or downloadable. Additionally, replays from before updates will be cleared with each major version update, so it's recommended to use other software for screen recording to save your favorite replays in a timely manner. The current frequency of major updates is approximately once every 3 months, but unexpected situations may arise that require clearing.

2、Re-enabled the Season Shop:
i) All current season currency will be uniformly converted to previous season currency.
ii) Players who have purchased the two skins of [Melisende] will receive the corresponding previous season currency after this maintenance ends.

3、Temujin's Q skill [Bolas] now has a cooldown of 20 seconds if it fails to hit any targets.

4、Fixed the issue where Temujin could infinitely throw Q skill by switching weapons; also added a feature that switches back to the previous weapon after using the Q skill.

5、Fixed the issue where the synthesis of the Blade Light effect failed for Temujin. For players who attempted to synthesize the Blade Light effect during this period, we will send the synthesis materials [Tough Steel *5] via mail, and we suggest you check your mail and synthesize again to activate it.

6、Fixed the issue where the [Tiandi Yingjie Blind chest Deduction Coupon] could not be used; after this maintenance, we will compensate the additional credits spent for the affected players.

7、Fixed the issue where enabling "Image Enhancement Technology" in game settings would result in a black screen.

8、Optimized the prompt text for [Battlepass Store - Soldier Costume], obtaining a Soldier Costume Voucher or purchasing a battlepass can unlock the exchange for soldier skins.

9、Fixed the issue where Zhuge Liang, Huang Yueying, and Zhen Ji, when switching to a ranged weapon, could not shoot at their feet due to the melee angle limit.

10、Fixed the BUG where the Flying crow rocket could hit enemies with damage but no damage numbers were displayed.

11、Fixed the issue where Qi Jiguang's weapon model was displayed incorrectly when using a common weapon with the main weapon set to the default weapon.

12、Fixed the issue where Cecilia's zombie soldiers' attacks were ineffective.

13、Corrected the error in the description of Napoleon's passive skill [Lion in the Wild], which actually states "0.3% of the strategy points are restored for each artillery hit on the target."

14、Corrected the error in the description of Zhuge Liang's skill [Decoy], which actually states "the dummy does not trigger hit/kill judgment."

15、Fixed the issue of abnormal movement speed in the territory war.

16、Fixed the issue where the price of the Normal Battlepass was displayed incorrectly on the English version of the Battlepass interface.

17、Fixed the issue of residual Chinese text in the English version of the Video Hall.

Update content: 

1. Temporarily close the [Rank Match-Season Store] entrance, and we will perform the following processing in the next version:
        i) All coins of the current competition year will be uniformly converted to coins of previous competition years.
        ii) Currently, the 2 skins of [Melisende] in the [Current Season Store] are temporarily unable to be obtained. Players who have purchased them will have the corresponding previous season coins returned in a later version; no additional processing will be done for the remaining 4 products.
