notes.title: "Blood of Steel" Version Update Announcement – August 1st
notes.content:
To ensure the game's stability and enhance overall service quality and user experience, "Blood of Steel" will undergo maintenance on August 1st from 09:00 to 13:00 (UTC+8). During this period, the game world will be temporarily closed, and game matchmaking will be disabled around 08:45. Additionally, comprehensive maintenance and backup of the account database will be performed. Please notice that the maintenance time may change based on specific work conditions. We kindly ask all players to plan the game time accordingly.

Update Content:

I. New Features:

1. Battle Pass Overhaul:
   a. Core rewards have been adjusted to include: Inherited Hero Roxana of Alexander*1, Kaihime Skins*2, Main and Secondary Weapons for Kaihime*4, Soldier Costumes*4, and Self-selected Horse Chest*3. For detailed rewards, please log in to the game for more information.
   b. The price of the Normal Battlepass has been adjusted, while the price of the Advanced Battlepass remains unchanged. Activating any Battlepass will grant you 2 exchange privileges in the "Battlepass Store - Soldier Return."

   c. The "Lide Reward" for purchasing the Advanced Battlepass has been changed to a [Frame Voucher] and a [Soldier Costume Voucher], which can be exchanged in the Battlepass Store for any Battlepass Frame (including new Frames of the current period) and Soldier Costume; the Soldier Costume Voucher does not count towards the purchase limit.

   d. "Battlepass Awakening" has been fully upgraded to the【Battlepass Store】, where you can use Battlepass Tokens to exchange for any rewards, including 22 returning Soldier Costumes, Self-selected Battlepass Skin Chest, and Self-selected Battlepass Weapon & Cloak Chest (the returning Soldier Costumes will refresh with the season). The original "Battlepass Awakening" entry is now closed.

   e. The "Awakening Rating" in "Battlepass Awakening" will be converted at a 1:1 ratio to "Battlepass Crystal Shards." Please claim them via mail after maintenance. Additionally, Battlepass Crystal Shards can be exchanged for Battlepass Tokens in the "Other Products" section of the Battlepass Store. "Battlepass Crystal Shards*100" can be synthesized into "Battlepass Crystal*1" in the warehouse.
   f. The Battlepass Crystal Store has been moved to the "Battlepass Store" and will not refresh with the seasons in the future.
   g. The output of Battlepass Tokens from some in-game Chests has been adjusted to other valuable items.
   h. During this Battlepass period, any player who unlocks advanced rewards (purchasing either the Normal Battlepass or the Advanced Battlepass) can receive the【New Season Pack】in the "Activity Center - New Season Gift" event. Upon use, you can choose to receive either a "Battlepass Voucher (1000 YCP)" or "Battlepass Tokens*100" (the Battlepass Voucher is valid for 120 days and can be used for the next Battlepass deduction).
       

2. The Rank-legion (with map changes), Territory War, and Elite Contest seasons are concluding and will be followed by the start of new seasons.

3. A new replay function has been added to 5V5 Legion Rank Matches and City Rank Match. Players can download their matches from the Match History and view them in the "Video Hall."
4. The New Season Store's featured skin is Melisende's【Pirate Series】. With the currency adjustment for this season's store, the new season's skin will be available for redemption in the following season. The store currency has been unified and adjusted: any unspent currency from the current season will automatically be converted into historical currency when the new season begins. The Season Store is divided into the Historical Season Store and the Current Season Store, where corresponding currencies can be used for redemption.

5. Base Heroes and Inherit Heroes now share a common mount, meaning that Base Heroes can equip the horses of Inherit Heroes, and vice versa. This applies to heroes including: Huang Zhong and Huang Wudie, Alexander and Roxana.

6. The Reputation cap has been extended to 15,000, with the addition of the new Reputation rank【God Emperor】.

7. For all players who have obtained the Koxinga【Red Gallbladder Lonely Loyalty】skin, we will send a matching horse【Elegant Ink Blood】, on the day of maintenance. Players who have already received this skin should check their in-game mail at that time; for those who will obtain the【Red Gallbladder Lonely Loyalty】skin later, we will compile the list every Thursday and distribute the horse via email.

8. The visual presentation of the Edinburgh map has been revamped.

9. The Main World Rank-legion season is concluding, and a new season will be initiated.

10. The Main World Battlepass has been updated.


II. Optimizations and Adjustments:

1. Hero Reworks:
   a. Temujin:
      - Reclassified from Bow Horsemen to melee cavalry units, with corresponding numerical adjustments.
      - Melee weapon changed to a two-handed knife, ranged weapon arrows change to 8 shots, and the troop now has blue armor.
      - New Hero Passive Ability: Starts with 100% initial focus points, which gradually regenerate over time.
      - Unit Passive Ability adjusted to: Using the [Mangu's tactics], for each enemy soldier put into [Rage], Temujin's focus regenerates by 1.5%.
      - Q skill [Bolas] cooldown increased to 45 seconds; if no targets are hit, the cooldown is reduced to 5 seconds.
      - Army skill [Mangu's tactics]: The army regains 8 arrows, switches to longbows, and performs [Harassment shooting] (Effect: Long-range shots at enemy troops, shots that are defended against or hit will accumulate 1|2 layers of [Angry] for enemy soldiers. When [Angry] reaches 4 layers, the soldier enters [Rage] status, at which point the soldier no longer obeys orders and attacks for 15 seconds).
      - Army skill [Cantabrian Circle]: Consumes 80% of focus to activate, resets the cooldown time of [Mangu's tactics], and summons 6 Bow Horsemen to perform [Cantabrian Circle], lasting up to 30 seconds.
      - Army skill [Line Archery]: Commands the army to form a line, increasing attack power.

   b. Hua Mulan:
      - Skill [Iron Eagle] reset.
      - The Iron Eagle remains active and automatically attacks targets within range, following the main general's head by default. It can be controlled with F5.
      - While the Iron Eagle is active, using the Secondary Weapon throwing daggers to hit an enemy will mark them. Only one mark can exist at a time, lasting 30 seconds. The Iron Eagle prioritizes attacking marked targets and doubles the lock-on attack range.
          

2. Hero Balance Adjustments:
   a. Edward I:
      - Added Blue Armor mechanism, removed Out-of-combat Recovery mechanism.
      - Added [Rapid March] skill: Increases movement speed for the hero and troops for 30 seconds.
   
b. Yi Seong-gye:
      - Focus points adjustment: Removed focus gain from hero attacks, initial focus set to 100%, recovery rate increased from 0.3% to 1% per second; when Poison Arrow target dies, hero regains 3% focus.
      - [Herbal Mist] skill: Now lasts for 10 seconds, heals once every second, sharing 120 healing points (up to 30 points).
      - [Poison Arrow] skill: Now costs 80% focus to activate.
   
c. Wang Yangming:
      - Added Out-of-combat Recovery mechanism.
      - [Flying Crow Rocket] skill cooldown reduced to 60 seconds.
   
d. Liang Hongyu:
      - Added focus points mechanism: Initial focus 100%, recovery rate 1% per second; extra focus gained when hitting enemies.
      - [Oil Arrow] skill: Now costs 50% focus and creates a Fire Circle with reduced damage over time.
   
e. Inahime:
   - Reduced health consumption rate: The health cost every 5 seconds is decreased from 40|20 to 30|15 for the hero and soldiers, respectively.
   
f. Margaret:
      - Added Out-of-combat Recovery mechanism.
      - Added [Ammunition] skill: Costs 60% focus point to replenish 3 rock shots.
 
  g. Richard I:
   - Added Blue Armor mechanism.
   - Skill [Steady]: duration extended to 30 seconds.
   - Rage trigger conditions adjusted: Activated when health and Blue Armor combined reach half of the total.

h. Diao Chan:
   - Adjusted to recover 1% of focus points per second, with additional focus points gained when the entire army is attacked.
   - Skill [Shield Rush] adjusted: Costs 60% of focus points, and using it refreshes the Q skill [Victory Rush].
   - Skill [Turtle Formation]: now tighter, melee damage reduction increased from 15% to 20%, and ranged damage reduction increased from 15% to 50%.
   - Skill [Echelon Formation]: increases movement speed, changed from reducing defense to reducing attack power.

i. Victoria:
   - Added Blue Armor mechanism.

j. Caesar:
   - Significantly increased the damage reduction against ranged attacks for the skill [Testudo Formation].
   - Skill [Throw] adjusted to consume 80% of focus points.

k. Leonidas:
   - Reduced the amount of rage gained when Leonidas hits or kills enemies.
   - Skill [Targe Array] adjusted to decrease the defensive effective range when soldiers are out of position.
   - Skill [Javelin] increased the focus point cost to 40%.

l. Zhuge Liang:
   - Added Out-of-combat Recovery mechanism.
   - Skill [Decoy] now costs 40% of focus points, with a reduced cooldown to 1 second.
   - Skill [Arbalest] cooldown reduced to 1 second.
   - Skill [Daoist Magic] cooldown increased to 90 seconds, lasts for 20 seconds; during Daoist Magic, Zhuge Liang's Repeating Crossbow shots do not consume ammunition for 20 seconds.

m. Lagertha:
   - Added Blue Armor mechanism.
   - Skill [Odyn's Fury] now includes shield replenishment: when activated, it can replenish damaged shields for both generals and soldiers, and also replenish health for undamaged shields.
   - The heavy attack of the double-handed axe now adopts a non-interruptive mode.

n. Da Qiao:
   - Skill [Oil Pot]: The explosion damage of the Oil Barrel is halved, and the burning damage is reduced to 3 points per second.
   - Skill [Flame Crossbow] (Q ability): [Panic] can now stack up to 3 times, with damage values adjusted from 2|4|6 to 2|3|5, and the burn duration reduced from 15 seconds to 12 seconds.

o. Kaihime:
   - Increased the base attack of the main weapon.
   - Skill [Hell March] duration increased to 10 seconds; during this time, soldiers' attacks will knock down enemy soldiers; when the rage meter is full, the cooldown of Hell March is reduced by 10 seconds.

p. Liu Bei:
   - Added Out-of-combat Recovery mechanism.
   - Removed the effect of reducing the cooldown of [Inspiration] and gaining more Focus when Liu Bei kills an enemy.
   - The passive ability [Indoctrinator] is adjusted: Gaining Focus when hitting a target, with long-range hits granting double Focus.
   - Skill [Inspiration] is adjusted: After use, Liu Bei performs an AOE healing and provides a buff that increases the attack and both armor types for allies within a certain range for 20 seconds. Allies with this buff increase Liu Bei's Focus when they deal damage.
   - Skill [Indoctrination] now has an additional effect: It reduces the cooldown of [Inspiration] by 8 seconds when used.
   - Skill [Reinforcement] now has an additional effect: It reduces the cooldown of [Inspiration] by 5 seconds when used.
   - Adjusted the heavy attack mode of the double-wielded sword.

q. Qi Jiguang:
   - Added Out-of-combat Recovery mechanism.
   - Skill [Wolf Spear] now has an additional effect: When the general defeats an enemy, the cooldown of [Open Fire] is reduced by 4 seconds.

r. Cai Wenji:
   - Added Out-of-combat Recovery mechanism.
   - Skill [Sky Lantern] adjusted: Now costs 40% of Focus to release, and deploys two Sky Lanterns at once.
   - Each time a Sky Lantern hits a unit, it reduces the cooldown of [Blessing] by 0.5 seconds.
   - Skill [Blessing] adjusted: Reduces the pre-cast time of Blessing, healing now only affects the general, restoring 240 health points and 80% of Focus after activation.

s. Cecilia:
   - Added Out-of-combat Recovery mechanism.
   - Sepulcher Keepers no longer trigger effects from being attacked or killed (such as gaining rage or reducing cooldowns).

t. Alexander:
   - Skill [Phalanx Formation] now provides 50% damage reduction against ranged attacks.
   - Increased the striking frequency of [Phalanx Advance].

u. Sarutobi Sasuke:
   - Shadow Clones no longer trigger effects from being attacked or killed (such as gaining rage or reducing cooldowns).

v. Napoleon:
   - Added Out-of-combat Recovery mechanism.
   - Added an effect where artillery hits on enemies return Focus Points based on the number of enemies hit.
   - Increased ranged damage reduction when Napoleon is on the vehicle, optimizing the real hit area when the general is reloading. After the adjustment, the reloading action's hit area will be covered by the artillery's hit area, effectively blocking long-range damage coming from the front.
   - Increased the knockdown time and blast distance of artillery shells.

w. Deng Ai:
   - Increased the ranged attack power of the skill [Diamond Formation].

x. Catherine:
   - Added Out-of-combat Recovery mechanism.
   - Enhanced the base recovery speed of Focus.
   - The general's musket kills can now also trigger the terror effect.

y. Joan:
   - Added Out-of-combat Recovery mechanism.
   - The passive skill [Victory Banner] is adjusted so that when Joan or soldiers defeat enemies, it reduces the cooldown of [Bless] by 6 seconds for Joan and 3 seconds for soldiers.
   - Using the legion skill [Bless], the [AID] effect is adjusted so that when released, it provides a shield that absorbs up to 80 points of damage for a certain number of allied troops around, lasting for 30 seconds; while the shield lasts, the protected will not be interrupted by attacks.

z. Huang Zhong:
   - Passive skill [Focused Shot] adjusted so that when the general hits or defeats a target, the cooldown of [Rapid Shoot] is reduced by 3 or 10 seconds, respectively.

3. Weapon Mechanism, Combat Operation, and Presentation Optimizations:

a. Two-handed hammer and two-handed mace have had their attack level changed to 3 and defense level changed to 4.

b. UI optimization: After an attack on an enemy is parried or blocked, the damage number area next to the target will display the corresponding defensive icon.

c. Calibration of weapon (one-handed sword, one-handed knife, one-handed axe, one-handed hammer, two-handed sword, two-handed knife, two-handed axe, two-handed mace, two-handed hammer, spear, fighting spear, long-handle blade, poleaxe, hand sword, halberd, fishgig, rod) hit accuracy.

d. Some generals' weapons have added a combo move for enhanced normal attacks:
   - The next attack after the first normal attack can trigger an enhanced normal attack as long as it's not in the opposite direction.
   - Enhanced normal attack: +1 target | noticeable change in the attack motion.
   - Involves generals and weapons such as Caesar with one-handed sword, Diao Chan and Ling Tong with one-handed sword, Zhang Bao (Zhang Xingcai) with one-handed knife, and spear.

e. Shield mechanism changes:
   - All shields have increased base health recovery rate.
   - Supply points can replenish shield health, even for destroyed shields.
   - After a shield is destroyed, using F1 or F2 will cause shieldless soldiers to swap positions with soldiers who have shields.

4. Balance adjustments have been made to the Hulao Town Siege (6V5) and Crac des Chavaliers Siege (6V5/10V8) maps to improve gameplay fairness and flow.

5. Graphic settings have been optimized by removing the rendering mode selection and adding an "Image Enhancement Technology" option. Players can now choose settings based on their hardware (NVIDIA cards can use DLSS, AMD cards can use FSR) to enhance their visual experience.

6. The T key action voice playback rule has been modified: pressing the T key at any time will play the action voice, and other actions can interrupt the animation, but the voice will continue to play. Players can now hold still to play the full action animation.

7. Joan's special slash action has been restored, adding a unique touch to her gameplay.

8. The Changle Palace map has been added to the Ranked Legion, providing a new environment for competitive play.

9. The Constantinople Siege map has received a Respawn Point protection mechanism. A green barrier has been added around the defender's respawn points, preventing the attacking side from crossing through it.

III. Bug Fixes:

1. Fixed a bug where Huang Wudie's bow accuracy was not as good as Huang Zhong's.
2. Resolved an issue that Zhu Rong's dog would become uncontrollable while being commanded.
3. Corrected a bug that caused empty player icons to appear for Inherit Heroes when they were disabled.
4. Addressed a bug where Napoleon's cannon would cause camera stutter when rotated using the AD keys.
5. Fixed a bug in the Babel Tower map of the Main World where some objects in the Old Valley did not have collision.
6. Resolved a bug that could cause abnormalities when Arthur and Victoria performed their slash actions.
7. Fixed a bug where Cai Wenji's lanterns would not explode normally when released from the gate tower.
8. Adjusted the slash actions for Da Qiao, Cai Wenji, Joan, Cecilia, and Agrippina when using a Two-handed Sword to ensure they are performed correctly.
9. Corrected the slash actions for Huang Yueying, Sun Shangxiang, Diao Chan, Xiao Qiao, Zhen Ji, Isabella, Octavia, Inahime, and Margaret when using a Sword and Shield to prevent any anomalies.

notes.title: A letter to the players of 《Blood of Steel》
notes.content:
Dear lords,

Sorry to keep you waiting.

There have been some serious problems in the recent version, which have caused a series of downtime, freezes and other problems, which have affected the normal experience of many players. We would like to express our sincerest apologies to all of you. We are well aware of the magnitude of this problem and are fully committed to finding a solution. We rewrote the code related to the underlying interaction of some servers, modified the game engine mechanism, and adjusted the load capacity of the battlefield server. Although some problems were solved, some related problems were also caused. Due to the long duration of the project and the huge amount of code, this round of repair encountered many unexpected problems and took a lot of time.

Fortunately, there has been a major breakthrough in this problem recently, and it is believed that the problem of game lag will be solved soon. Thank you for sticking with us during this special time. Last week's version has been updated to fix some server lag issues, and this week will continue to fix the rest. We expect to solve most of the problems in next week's update, which caused the delay of the new version. I hope players can understand us Decision to prioritize stability issues.

Since its launch in May 2017 for 6 years, 《Blood of Steel》 has gained the support and love of a large number of players. Looking back on this period of time, we are sincerely grateful. We started from the same starting line as many cold weapon competitive games back then, trying to push this type of Mount&Blade games to more players, but only a few of them could persist until the end. Fortunately, because of your perseverance, we can go so far. We are deeply aware that players are always our treasure and the most precious person. Only by serving players well and allowing them to experience the fun of the game can the game develop for a long time.

In the future, we will make major upgrades to the technical part, improve the running speed of the client, improve the picture quality, and reduce the package capacity, so as to lay a solid foundation for the subsequent long-term operation and avoid similar problems.

In order to thank the players for their understanding and tolerance, we have prepared some activities and rewards.

1. Generals give it for free
After the next week's update, all players who log in will be able to get a general selection package including new generals (received in the game).

2. Special Battle Pass rewards
The Battle Pass will be updated next week. In order to thank the players for their support, we have decided to make a special Battle Pass.
Players who purchase Battle Pass for this period will receive additional reward packages.

I look forward to 《Blood of Steel》 can accompany you for another 5 years, 10 years, or even longer! Thank you again for your tolerance and support for our game.

notes.title: Vote For Your Troop SKins
notes.content:
During the event, from July 13 to July 20 (UTC+8), players can vote daily for their favorite troop skins.At the end of the event, we will select the top 8 troop skins according to the ranking of skin votes, and they will be available in the follow-up summer event.Only players who have purchased any Battle Pass in 2022 can participate in subsequent return events.

Log in the game and click "Activity Center" on the right

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/68ad78be0d8c1d926ea5ead56496d9bde312df98.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/074cf69186d6ddfcac95a7f8f9c178a7a19955bd.jpg[/img]

【Event Time】
July 13 to July 20 (UTC+8)


【How To Get Battot】

1.Play a match everyday to get 1 battot（up to 5 per day）

2. After voting every day,you can get 1 troop skin exchange voucher(up to 2 per day).The voucher can be used to exchange for legion skins in subsequent skin return events.



【Event rules】
1. The exchange voucher can only be used after the official exchange event starts.

2. The exchange vouchers obtained in the voting stage cannot be fully exchanged for a set of troop skins.

3. You need to continue to obtain more troop skin exchange vouchers after the official exchange event starts.

notes.title: Announcement On Subsequent Version Updates And Events

Dear lords,

Due to the epidemic prevention and control since March, the game development has been greatly development, and the game version update has been delayed. We would like to apologize to all the lords and thank you for your support.

We will also start events after the update, and you can receive 20,000+ awakening credits. We will organize more events in the future.

If you meet any problems in the game, contact us in discord or steam community. Thank you for your support!
 
Sincerely, 
The R&D and Operation Team of Blood of Steel

notes.title: Update Preview 9.0
notes.content:
Dear lords,
In August, we will welcome 2 new heroes: Meng Huo & Sarutobi Sasuke! 
Meng Huo will be officially released on August 3, and with it will be a brand new unit-War Elephant; Sasuke Sasuke, known as the head of Sanada Ten Braves s, will meet you at the end of August!

[The king of the south – Meng Huo]
The army led by Meng Huo consisted of 32 "Vine Armor Army". They all wore rattan armor made of vines. They had a higher resilience point than the general army. At the same time, the army was also equipped with shields and spears, which can resist long-range attacks, and can also be used for mid-to-close-range throwing attacks.

Another major feature of Meng Huo is "Summon War Elephant." When riding war elephant in a high-speed impact state, they can rush the enemy back. You can also use the skill “Ivory's Sweeping” to command the war elephant to sweep the ivory [Fly away]. The enemy is an indestructible weapon in the battlefield.

Let us take a look at the specific skills introduction of Meng Huo!

[previewyoutube=GwIdJaG_H8U;full][/previewyoutube]

Hero Passive - Castle of Beast

When Warfare Elephant is stopped suddenly at high speed, it could blow away enemies.
Warfare Elephant will not be influenced by [Fear Horse] effect. [Toggle Spear-Wall] and [Phalanx Formation] could influence warfare elephant.

Unit Passive - Raising Our Spirits

Meng Huo and his legion possess higher resilience point, but suffer more damage from fire.

Hero Skill 3 - Shields Up
Command troops to wield shields to defend.

Hero Skill 4 - Spear Throw
The unit unleashes a barrage of spears at the enemy targets within range whenever they see fit in 10 seconds. Each troop fires up to 1 spear.

Hero Skill 5 - Summon elephant
Meng Huo summons an elephant in the area where the cavalry can move and knock down enemy troops on contact at high mounted movement speed

Hero Skill 6 – Ivory's Sweeping
Order your warfare elephant to sweeping his ivories. Enemies who are attacked will [fly away].

Q skill - Pot of Gas
Meng Huo throws a Miasma Jar to designated region. When Miasma Jar explodes, it causes damage to enemies for one time within that region and produce miasma within that area. This miasma will reduce the moving speed of enemies within that area and cause incessant damage to them. This miasma can only last 15 seconds.

【Sarutobi Sasuke】
Sasuke Sarutobi is one of the three major ninjas in Japan, who is proficient in Koga-ryu ninjutsu. 
Sasuke Sarutobi can use the shadow clone to make him and the legion create shadow doubles in place to confuse the enemy, and the main body enters a hidden state to quietly approach the enemy. At the same time, Sasuke Sasuke can use Thunder's Cut to swap positions with the shadow clone and make the enemy elusive!

[previewyoutube=OiyrVGAB2Cs;full][/previewyoutube]

Hero Passive - Cloud Stalker
When Sarutobi Sasuke's melee attack hits enemies successfully, 10% of his focus will be added. When his focus reaches 100%, it will be consumed automatically and one Shadow Clone will be summoned. 
Every shadow could exist no longer than 30 seconds, and no more than 3 shadows could coexist together.

Unit Passive - Koga Jutsu
If there is shadow's substitute on the battlefield, when legion's unit is killed, their death will be replaced by the disappearing of one shadow's substitute, and this unit will gain 200 HP.
After getting off from battle, both Sarutobi Sasuke and his unit would gradually regain their HP.

Hero Skill 3 - Shadow Clone Jutsu
Sarutobi Sasuke and his unit instantly get into the state of [Disappeared Shadow], and leave a Shadow Clone/Shadow's Substitute at the original spot.
Shadow's Substitute has much lower attack ability and HP, and they are not controllable. They exist for no longer than 45 seconds.
[Disappeared Shadow]: Enables Sasuke and his unit to be invisible, greatly improves their moving speed for 8 seconds. When enemies detect units under the state of [Disappeared Shadow], [Invisible Enemies Detected] icon will not be shown.

Hero Skill 4 - Shadow Blade Jutsu
Improve the attacking speed of Sarutobi Sasuke and his unit for 20 seconds, meanwhile refresh the cd for [Shadow•separation] directly.

Hero Skill 5 – Shadow meld Jutsu
Improve the attacking speed of Sarutobi Sasuke and his unit for 20 seconds, meanwhile refresh the cd for [Shadow•separation] directly.

Q skill - Thunder's Cut
Release a range attack, then exchange location with a shadow's substitute within 250 yards randomly.

notes.title: Update Preview 8.0
notes.content:
Hi, lords!

Welcome to the update preview. We are going to introduce you to a new hero - Mary I, who will be released on July 6th.

Bloody Mary I

Mary I was the fifth king of England and the fourth king of Ireland in the Tudors. Her devotion to Catholicism was so enthusiastic that she brutally burned more than 300 opponents to death, so she was also called "Bloody Mary" by the world! Let us take a look at the skills introduction of Mary I!

[previewyoutube=-D19KExp36I;full][/previewyoutube]

Hero Passive - Bloody Offspring

Melee attack of Mary I will exert [Bleeding] effect to enemy (6 layers at most).
When Mary I's rage reaches 100%, they will be consumed automatically. Mary I will go in to the state of [Hier of Blood] for 12 seconds. Mary I and her legion could recover after getting into the state. Mary I's moving and attacking speed would be increased during the state. And every attack of Mary I could add 2 extra layers of [Bleeding] effect. CD for skill Q (Reap in Silence) could be reduced.

Hero Skill 3 - Bloody Sacrifice

During the time of [Red Sacrifice], Mary I'Legion could exert 2 layers [Bleeding] effect to enemy for 20 seconds. Enemy will suffer from continuous damage for 6 seconds. After reaching 2 layers, every 2 more layers could level up your damage for one stage.



Hero Skill 4 – Scarlet's Sudden Attack 

Order your legion to rush to designated point. Moving speed will be increased for 8 seconds. Legion's first attack will exert [Bleeding] effect to the enemy during this period.


Q skill – Reap in Silence 

Mary I’s [Powerful Sweeping] could cause damage to enemy. And enemy who is hit will suffer [Bleeding] effect, which will deal extra damage. 
When enemy is hit by [Reap in Silence], 15% HP of Mary I will be recovered (20 points at least). When an enemy is hit by [Reap in Silence], Mary I will gain rages. When a unit is killed, Mary I will gain extra rages, and when a hero is killed, Mary I’rages will reach 100%. When Mary I is under the state of [Hier of Blood], Mary I will change her attacking numbers and postures.

notes.title: Update Preview 7.0
notes.content:
Dear Lords,

Welcome to the preview of the update. Today we will introduce you to a brand new hero who will meet you in June-Dian Wei, a hero who will not retreat to the last minute! 
At the same time, the new Stardust Skin will also be released in June, so stay tuned!

1. Ancient Vicious – Dian Wei

Dian Wei was a strong hero during the Three Kingdoms period. He was a burly man with extraordinary arm strength. The Tiger Shieldman led by him has the skill “Undying Rage”. With the skill “Last Stand” they can increase attack power. In addition, Dian Wei also has good endurance. After separating from the fight, he can provide a large amount of recovery for his army. The reasonable use of Dian Wei's skills can make the fight more and more courageous, thereby changing the situation! 
Let's take a look at Dian Wei's specific skills!


[previewyoutube=PYqI5qRWb0I;full][/previewyoutube]


Hero Passive - Faithful Bodyguard
Dian Wei's attack power will be increased if his HP is lower than 10%.

Unit Passive - Tiger's Might
Killing an enemy makes the duration of [Undying Rage] 1.5 seconds longer, and reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds. If Dian Wei's troop died from [Undying Rage]'s damage, Dian Wei gains rages. This ability cannot make [Undying Rage] last for longer than its maximum duration.

Hero Skill 3 – Shields Up
Command troops to wield shields to defend

Hero Skill 4 – Blood Feast
Costs 30% rages and restores a total of 1800 HP for Dian Wei and his unit. Each troop or Dian Wei himself can restore up to 240 HP.

Hero Skill 5 - Battle Fury
Costs 70% rages and orders the unit to switch to use dual blades, increasing attack power for 20 seconds.


Hero Skill 6 – Undying Rage
The whole unit enters [Undying Rage] state and increases attack speed. Lasts for 15 seconds.

In [Undying Rage] state:

Dian Wei and his unit's HP will not fall below 1, but when their HP is equal to 1, their movement speed will be reduced.

All healings Dian Wei and his unit received will be stored and won't be applied to them immediately. When the state ends, the stored healings will be doubled and apply to them.

At the end of [Undying Rage] state:

Dian Wei and his unit take damage equal to all the damage they received in the [Undying Rage] state. If the doubled stored healings cannot recover their HP higher than 0, they will die immediately.

2. Stardust Skin

In June, a new Stardust Skin is coming, and Liang Hongyu will be unveiled in a new outfit! 
Gothic style, or business-casual clothes, which one is your dish? 
(The pre-skin of Liang Hongyu Stardust Skin is "Shiny Beauty" & "Passing Beauty")


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/236059b2e2407d295d58d23d9c3036ac27da1415.jpg[/img]


With the update of Liang Hongyu's Stardust Skin, Stardust epic skin of Diao Chan "Star Bright: Imperial" will also be released.
To use Diao Chan's Stardust epic skin, you need the pre-skin "Rose Empress".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/7db78b98a68a1c514bc371466b16e32f70045794.jpg[/img]

notes.content:

The official will directly sign contracts and provide subscriptions and game item rewards with 20 streamers who registered the event, meet the event requirements, and have the subscription rights of twitch.

Requirements: The total live stream time should be more than 30 hours, and the valid days should be more than 15 days. It will be counted as valid days, only if the live lasts for more than one hour in the category Blood of Steel. We will select the 20 streamers with the highest total live duration

Registration method: send the server, player code, twitch channel link and the number of followers to the official mailbox binbin.cai@ycgame.com.

notes.content:
Dear lords,

To make sure the stability of the game operation and improve the service quality and experience, Blood of Steel will be shut down for maintenance and update from 5:00 to 9:00 UTC on January 19, 2021. The game world will be closed at that time.

Patch Notes:

[New Hero]
1. Release new hero Kaihime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/258c2f8e4f4408b5cc66944e95ec954accd53dda.jpg[/img]

[Balance Adjustment]

1. Sibylla: Add Snipe Formation, which can reduce the movement speed, increase the ranged attack, and reduce the hero's charge attack damage (reduced the damage of charged shooting from 1.1 times to 1.05 times)

2. Qin Qiong: the mace will resume one shot every 30 seconds.

3. Catherine: 
a) Reduce the 3 random skills to 2. The [Supplies] and [Captives] are merged into [Provisions]. When the troops are not full, the effect is to supplement 1 unit; otherwise it is to restore the HP
b) When the loot reaches 100%, the player must be given 2 skills (1 each for [Provisions] and [Ammunition]) instead of randomly given 1 from 3
The duration of restoring HP effect of [Provisions] is reduced to 15 seconds, and the amount of [Ammunition] is reduced to 4 shoots each time
c) New trophy drop mechanism. There’s chance to drop trophies when killing units with special effects in the battlefield. Trophy must be dropped when killing heroes, regardless of whether it is killed by Catherine 
d) Catherine from the same team can pick up trophy from each other, but not from the trophies from enemy

4. When the cavalry horse dies, the hero or the unit will fall to the ground and need to get up.

5. Deng Ai: Increase defense of units of Deng Ai.

6. Ma Chao: Unit charge skill will have the lowest starting speed.

7. Ranged damage taken by all ranger heroes and their units is reduced by 20%

8. Slightly increase left and right slash attack speed of two-handed weapons of Spartacus, Liu Bei, and Harald. Slightly reduce attack power.

9. Increase cleave damage of double swords of Spartacus, double mace of Qin Qiong, and double axes of Harald unit

10. Lady Zhurong: reduces the CD of [Replenish Arrows] from 90 seconds to 60 seconds

11. Fixed the bug that shield defense did not take effect. 
Adjusted the HP and defense of all shields. Currently, crushing damage will break shields faster than before.



[System Update]

After playing for such a period of time, we believe that many lords may have encountered some experience problems, in this update, we will gradually optimize and adjust this part.

1. First of all, we will add support for 64 bit systems. Due to the operating system and underlying technology constraints, the current 32-bit system only supports 3.75 GB of memory, some players may have encountered game jams and keyboard and mouse failure, which seriously affects their in-game experience, as well as the cooperation of battlefield with friends. Therefore, we also suggest that if your system is still 32-bit, upgrade the system to a 64-bit system as soon as possible.

2. The UI global zoom function will also be available in this update. In the future, the UI display can be scaled in high resolution (such as 4K) and in window mode. greatly enhances the game experience.

3. Allow to switch resolution in full screen mode

4. The old Hero info interface cannot be very intuitive to view the relevant information. In this regard, in this update, we have the whole hero info interface remastered, the interface will be more clear so that players can more quickly understand the relevant information of the Hero.



[Map Update]

1. Warrior Training scene optimization	
As a hardcore medieval game, we always think that the experience of beginner's training is very important so that players can start faster. A good scene can let the player have an immersive feeling so that players can have a real experience. Therefore, we have our Warrior training scene remastered. The remastered scene will be more expressive and shocking, which can let players have a more immersive experience, and also enable the players to understand and familiarize themselves with the game more quickly.

2. There is no longer any point-taking acceleration rule on the Legion War map with only one stronghold. The occupation time is adjusted to a unified 180 seconds.

3. Add a unified supply CD to arrow supply point: the supply point allows one player’s hero and units to replenish supply every 60 seconds. When a player completes a replenishment and the replenishment point is still in the cooling state, the prompt "Replenishment point is cooling down, x seconds remaining" will appear in the range of the replenishment point. Refresh the remaining cooling time and prompt once every 5 seconds.

4. There is no longer any point-taking acceleration rule of point A and B in Siege Battle stage 1. The occupation time is adjusted to a unified 60 seconds

5. Yumen Pass 6v5&10v8 siege battle map adjusted (Add the guards of the gates, etc).

6. Constantinople adjusted to 3-stage siege battle map.



[Game Mode Update]

1. Open Mercenary Shop, including material dismantling and material purchase

2. Section modification of the Ranked Legion War: Marquis section is restored to 5 sections, and 5 stars are added; inheritance rules are modified

3. World of Mercenaries adjustment
     a) Legend Battlefield is now available for some maps (Switch between the modes by clicking the Legend/Normal mode buttons on the world map)
       ★When the Legend mode is activated, the difficulty of some maps will be increased to an epic level
       ★The player must have at least one hero at level 51 to enter
       ★The player can only enter the Legend battlefield by forming a team of 5
       ★When entering, each person needs to consume a corresponding number of Zendar Tokens. Different maps consume a different number of Zendar Tokens.
       ★A [Supply Officer] will spawn when certain progress is reached in the Legend battlefield, Players can get great rewards from killing him
     b) Greatly reduce the difficulty of the conventional battlefield (low-level, intermediate, high-level, and top-level)
       ★The high-level and top-level materials in the chest of regular skin shards are replaced with the Zendar Tokens.
       ★The skin shards chests in the top area have removed all permanent skins, and can only be found when the [Supply Officer] is killed
     c) Greatly increased the speed of reputation acquisition in various areas
     d) The leaderboard of [World of Mercenaries] is now ranked according to the scores of Legend Mode
     e) The bond effects have been adjusted
     f) The time of World of Mercenaries will be adjusted from 8:00 in the morning to 2:00 in the evening every day. See details in the game

4. The new props experience ball will be for sale in World of Mercenaries, synthesized from 100 low-level materials, and the effect is to obtain 5000 World of Mercenaries PVE General EXP. It can be traded in Market.

5. Add two options of Zendar Tokens/Experience Ball in the selection of Market

6. In Ranked Legion War, the player will activate the background frame of Emperor Mark (permanent) when the player reaches 50 stars of Emperor

7. In Ranked Hero Arena, the player will activate the background frame of Challenger Mark (permanent) when the player reaches 50 stars of Challenger

8. Ranked Legion War open time extended to 02:00 (server time)


[Comprehensive update]

1. Random plates can be purchased 1-12 at a time
2. Added one-click collection function to the Battle Pass
3. The double experience will be opened within 7 days of new character creation

[BUG fixed]
1. Fixed several bugs

The previously reported content will be released one after another.

notes.title: Development Diary：64-bit system support, Gameplay adjustment, Five new heroes
notes.content:
Hello again, dear lords

 Welcome back to the developer log, we are overjoyed with all the great feed-backs after our last release this October. As many requested, we have been making steady progress on fixing bugs and addressing issues, we have made the decision to push out a huge release to January 2021 for a better gaming experience. Now, let’s have a little peek!

1. New Heroes

 We will bring you 5 new heroes, one after another in January, heroes from both Eastern and Western cultures, provides us with a wider range of tactical choices on different maps.

[Temujin]

Hero Story: 5 years before the Steel Era，The old Khan suddenly fell unconscious and was escorted by his sons to the legendary place to seek medical treatment. The Mongol Empire fell apart and died. Today, he calls on all the elite soldiers to return from the present. His goal is to conquer all the civilizations on the mainland and regain the pride of the Mongol Empire.

Hero Details: Khan's mounted Archer, led by Temujin, is able to form the [Cantabrian circle] and [Stagged Column] formations according to different situations, so as to master the battlefield advantages; Temujin can also call on Khan's Heavy Lancer to assist in combat at critical moments, and use skills at an appropriate time can change the situation of the enemy and ourselves or even turn the tide!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/2490af56503f8f7c006313de55cc7e8c5f7c131a.jpg[/img]

[Trajan]

Hero Story: In the center of this turbulent time like a storm, if a little weak, the newborn Roman Empire will be torn and swallowed by the herds. Therefore, Caesar invited his defeated king, Trajan, to help him consolidate the just unified Roman Empire. Under the careful management of Trajan, the economic development of Roman provinces was unprecedented. Then, just as the war was about to break out, Caesar disappeared and Trajan only hoped that the Roman Empire would have fewer desperate memorial ceremonies after the crisis is over.

Hero Details: Trajan is an all-around Warrior Hero with both attack and defense. Roman Auxiliary Footman can not only seize the key point with [Shield Rush] but also recover a certain amount of HP after disengaged from the battle, which gives him strong durability in the battlefield. furthermore, Roman auxiliary footman also has a unique ability of [Sheltered Volley], to throw javelins on 
Trajan's lead while the shield is up, causing a ton of damage to the enemy at medium and close range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/34546345ff08800e09043079dc3bf2804c654847.jpg[/img]

[Huo Qubing]

Hero Story: At that time, Liu Che and Baldwin IV met in secret. Temujin suddenly fell into the city, and the blade and arrow went straight to the two kings. Fortunately, Huo Qubing had a keen sense of war intuition, and timely rescue was able to avoid the death of the great man and the Crusader king at the same time. However, how the secret meeting was revealed, and who planned the plot to attack the city and kill the monarch? Many doubts made him toss and turn. Huo Qubing jumps on horseback, leaves the emperor, and returns to Changan to investigate the leak...

Hero Details: Hu Qubing is a Rider Hero who is extremely dependent on speed. His core ability [Conqueror's Might] can greatly improve the unit's attack power, attack speed, and damage reduction, the Focus required to trigger this skill is determined by the mounted move speed of Hu Qubing. In short, as long as Hu Qubing can run, He can always trigger the [Conqueror's Might] in a short time, so as to play a good effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/22cc7083a60f6f050a9800ea480bf4486987d87f.jpg[/img]

[Da Qiao]

Hero Story: With the revival of Mongolia, the new Khan of the Uzemchin tribe is eager to show his loyalty to the Great Khan. He raided the ranger's camp, seriously injured Sun Shangxiang, and captured Xiao Qiao. In the prison where the boorigit tribe traitor is held, Xiao Qiao reunites with her sister who has replaced her as the great shaman. Da Qiao awakens in the burning prison and swears to Ling Tong and others that she will shoulder the heavy responsibility in this world and lead Eastern Wu to regain dignity and prosperity.

Hero Details: [Crossbow with mounted flamethrower] is a unique weapon of Da Qiao. The flame can cause sustained damage in a wide range, and will also add debuff effect such as [Scared] and [Panic]. Therefore, Da Qiao is more suitable for large scale battle. It should be noted that the combination of [Crossbow with mounted flamethrower] and [Oil Pot] will cause more damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/a0acde34dd2da50f5855dbc50206d4367b18b5ff.jpg[/img]

[Cleopatra]

Hero Story: In Mongolia, Han Empire, Rome Empire, the Holy Kingdom kicked off. Unexpected events happened one after another, and the situation seemed to be in the hands of the yellow sand, gradually out of her control. With the irresistible rise of the fallen ancient civilization, the desert storm is about to sweep the temporarily stable situation and inject new turbulence into the four sides of the battlefield

Hero Details: Cleopatra's [Trial of Anubis] is a double-edged sword. During the [Trial of Anubis] competition, the party who first reaches the target damage amount, or the party with high damage amount at the end of the competition will win, the winner will get [Favour of Osiris], and the loser will get [Hatred of Anubis]. Reasonable use can help your team to build a huge advantage. If you do not use it properly, you will be in danger. She is a Warrior Hero with an extremely high upper limit and very low lower limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/fc5a019b0498964ed11d9284a2929d248a037514.jpg[/img]

2. New Maps

a) Penlai Port - Sector Control

Penglai port is a new Sector Control map of the Legion War, which supports 5v5 and 7v7 scale battles. Penglai port is divided into two parts: the surrounding city wall and the city's inner roadway. It mainly competes around the three objectives, and the victory can be achieved by taking the lead in obtaining scores or annihilating the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/57ceb1797e1b51f2fdd74475db77d6c25224a8e1.png[/img]

b) Warrior Training scene optimization	

As a hardcore medieval game, we always think that the experience of beginner's training is very important so that players can start faster. A good scene can let the player have an immersive feeling so that players can have a real experience. Therefore, we have our Warrior training scene remastered. The remastered scene will be more expressive and shocking, which can let players have a more immersive experience, and also enable the players to understand and familiarize themselves with the game more quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/653383dae1ee90201ea8aeba502824774ee78e2a.jpg[/img]

3. System Optimization

After playing for such a period of time, I believe that many lords may have encountered some experience problems, in this update, we will gradually optimize and adjust this part.

a) First of all, we will add support for 64 bit systems. Due to the operating system and underlying technology constraints, the current 32-bit system only supports 3.75 GB of memory, some players may have encountered game jams and keyboard and mouse failure, which seriously affects their in-game experience, as well as the cooperation of battlefield with friends. Therefore, we also suggest that if your system is still 32-bit, upgrade the system to a 64-bit system as soon as possible.

b) The UI global zoom function will also be available in this update. In the future, the UI display can be scaled in high resolution (such as 4K) and in window mode. greatly enhances the game experience.

4. Quest Optimization

a group of totally new and exciting Siege Quests is NOW available

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/44d09179a04235eb1a235774a9a2d840368d2e80.png[/img]

5. Game Play optimization

To make the game more fair and competitive is what we have been pursuing. In this update, we will optimize the game to make it more balanced.

1) Adjustment on Balance and Optimization for Heroes and their units.

2) The speed of capturing an objective is no longer depends on the number of participants.

3) There is only one chance for each individual combatant （Including Heroes and troops） to fully replenish its ammunition from the supply crate every 60 seconds.

4) World of Mercenaries
     a) Legend Battlefield is now available for some maps (Switch between the modes by clicking the Legend/Normal mode buttons on the world map)

       ★When the Legend mode is activated, the difficulty of some maps will be increased to an epic level

       ★The player must have at least one hero at level 51 to enter

       ★The player can only enter the Legend battlefield by forming a team of 5

       ★When entering, each person needs to consume a corresponding number of Zendar Tokens. Different maps consume a different number of Zendar Tokens.

       ★A [Supply Officer] will spawn when certain progress is reached in the Legend battlefield, Players can get great rewards from killing him

     b) Greatly reduce the difficulty of the conventional battlefield (low-level, intermediate, high-level, and top-level)

       ★The high-level and top-level materials in the chest of regular skin shards are replaced with the Zendar Tokens.

       ★The skin shards chests in the top area have removed all permanent skins, and can only be found when the [Supply Officer] is killed

     c) Greatly increased the speed of reputation acquisition in various areas

     d) The leaderboard of [World of Mercenaries] is now ranked according to the scores of Legend Mode

     e) The bond effects have been adjusted

5) Ranked Match Optimization
     Section modification of the Ranked Legion War: Marquis section is restored to 5 sections, and 5 stars are added; inheritance rules are modified

6. Hero Info Optimization

1) New Hero Info Interface
The old Hero info interface cannot be very intuitive to view the relevant information. In this regard, in this update, we have the whole hero info interface remastered, the interface will be more clear so that players can more quickly understand the relevant information of the Hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/01da46e9da4041ae982caddc94b5928a15e9a596.png[/img]

2) New Appearance Page
With the increasing of hero skins, weapon skins, accessories, and other related skins, each time we change the skin, you have to spend too much time on resetting. Therefore, in this update, we have added an appearance page function for Heroes. with the help of the appearance pages, we can save multiple sets of skin collocations. Moreover, after each battle, the skin can even be set to randomly switch.

Of course, our optimized development is never ended. We will continue to optimize and adjust in the future; thanks lords and any further suggestions are welcome!

notes.title: Update Preview 2.0 Advance and Secure
notes.content:
Dear Lords,

Let’s see the new game mode Advance and Secure, which will be launched next week. 

Advance and Secure is a dynamic offensive and defensive resurrection mode. Both sides have the ultimate goal of occupying the enemy's base. 
During the battle, both sides need to occupy the corresponding strongholds one by one in a fixed order. As long as the ownership of one of the strongholds changes, the offensive and defensive points will be changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/7ba7070e9b1c4fb9f48ab977c0a8d704514ca400.jpg[/img]

For example, in the new game mode, when the enemy has captured our defensive points and fully attacked the base, we can divide one team to defend the base, and the other team to attack the offensive point. Successfully occupying the offensive point can not only supplement the troops but also attack enemy defensive points.
Continue to capture the enemy's offensive points, you can switch to the offensive side, thus making the offensive and defensive conversion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/fab716d5dae8f29d90cdc97368d26a5941a720b0.jpg[/img]

Except for getting a victory by occupying the enemy's base, the first team that reaches 3000 points or the team with higher points at the end wins the match. Points can be obtained by killing heroes and units, occupying strongholds and banners
Therefore, if the enemy's stronghold cannot be forcibly occupied before the end of the time, you can get the victory by obtaining more points through tactical cooperation.

notes.title: Ask the Devs - #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/8012627e5c803faefbf24f48d812ae968bde0a86.png[/img]

[u][b]Qestion 1: [/b][/u]
Hi. Are there any player versus player tournaments? 1 against 1 2 against 2
[u][i]From u/Bibou_2_1[/i][/u]

[b]Answer:[/b]

Thanks for this interesting question. First, yes, Blood of Steel is a competitive game. We already hold national tournaments in China every year with great success, including 5v5 Legion Wars, Hero Arena, and this year we will also add Siege Battles as our top competition modes. Those modes are a great match when it comes to the competitive integrity of our game, and with our custom games, you also have the opportunity to host your own little tournaments! We are already attached to tournaments and have started to support the first player-made NA tournament a few weeks ago.  We are also really stoked to introduce official international tournaments like they already held in China in the future.


[u][b]Qestion 2: [/b][/u]
Here's one. Is there a specific game in the past that inspired you to make Blood of Steel? If so, which one?
[u][i]From u/Jeremy Gool[/i][/u]

[b]Answer:[/b]

In the early stage of our project called Blood of Steel, the game Mount & Blade gave us very much the inspiration for our creation and the way we want to head and develop this game. We always hoped to keep the gameplay differentiated from Mount & Blade in our full online experience, but at the same time, we also hope to do a subtraction for the hardcore gameplay of Mount & Blade,  hoping that more players can accept the simplified gameplay relatively easily. So this one is a really personal and exciting experience and journey for us, and we are glad to share some insights into our pre-release production!


[u][b]Qestion 3: [/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Hi there, is there a chance for Hungarian Black Army led by Pál Kinizsi to be added?
[*]In addition to the generals on the homepage of the game, will there be more generals?

notes.title: Introduction of the western generals in Blood of Steel
notes.content:
Blood of Steel is a game based on the alternative world. The famous kings and generals of the cold weapon era around the world in different period gather together in the  game. Player plays the general and leads their troops to win the battle.

Today, let's see the settings of those familiar generals in the Blood of Steel.

[h2][King of Holy City - Baldwin IV][/h2]

Baldwin IV is a cavalry general of crusaders. His lance will be hold in a high speed and deals significant damage on the first enemy unit to be struck. His skill cooldown time is very short and this makes him able to hit many times in a short period of time. In combination with the conical formation and the lance abilities, the cavalry can charge back and forth against enemies and quickly destroy the formation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/d7e9a8a0463a5d3f1a9ad053c326352c129d61bd.jpg[/img]

King's Bodyguards, leading by Baldwin IV, composed of chosen elite knight, who fought in the battle of Mongiza and destroyed Saladin's army at one stroke. King' Bodyguards are all armed with heavy plate armour, sophisticated with lance and extremely good at charge back and forth.

Advantage: high damage of lance, ability to break the formation.

Weakness: slow attack speed, weak melee ability

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/553c6e6b30b401d1a7f8383797c3229672d0a195.gif[/img]

[h2][Uncrowned King - Caesar]
[/h2]
Before the war, each of the ancient Roman legions would carry a spear and throw a round when they were still some distance away from the enemy, causing huge consumption. Then they would charge to start close combat. The damage caused by the spear could often give them an advantage in numbers and lead to the victory.

Similarly in the game, Caesar's spear does not strike at the same distance as a bow and arrow, but a heavy spear does more damage at a medium distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/0d4b123222a22284d2fb4fe1488277d60fa821ee.jpg[/img]

Another great strength of Caesar's is his "Turtle shell".

The outermost soldiers raise the shield and the central soldiers raise the shield above the head. It can defend from attack from the every side.

After approaching the enemy with a very low loss with the "Turtle shell", soldiers hide behind the shield, stab the dagger from the gap as far as possible to attack the enemy's vital points, losing a very small amount of blood in exchange for enemy serious injury or even death.

Advantage: high defense and high HP, spear can cause damage in the close range

Disadvantages: slow moving speed, low single attack

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/85a2182ef5e9278f308ad57ffcdc1561a670ebd3.gif[/img]

[h2][The King of Conquest - Alexander][/h2]

Alexander was a famous strategist and statesman in the ancient history of the world, as well as the first of the four greatest military commanders in the history of Europe.

He unified Greece, swept through the Middle East, conquered Egypt, captured the Persian empire, expanded the border to the Indus valley and occupied three of the four ancient civilizations in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/54701ad527b1223eec78d451292a4dd1c3a08d79.jpg[/img]

Alexander's Macedonian army is a powerful fighting force.

Formed into a phalanx, Macedonian phalanx soldiers will use the pike to attack and push away the enemy in front, which is very suitable for the defense of key terrain. Reasonable use of the phalanx to advance and adjusting the formation is able to nibble away at the opponent's army.

Advantage: after opening the pike phalanx, the frontal combat ability is very strong

Weaknesses: Macedonian Phalanx is difficult to deal with the attack from the side and the back

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36188276/13b405c395626452e2f9c69ecafccc16d23396f2.gif[/img]
